title: Digital Marketing Strategist / Social Media Manager
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE 

 

Project PEARLS is a dual-registered nonprofit (U.S. 501(c)(3) and Philippine PCNC-accredited NGO) that grew from a family-led feeding initiative in Ulingan, Tondo into a globally networked organization serving hundreds of scholars and families across five Philippine regions: Tondo, Bocaue (Bulacan), Naic, Cavite, Zamboanga Sibugay, and Siargao. Our work spans five program pillars - Hunger Relief, Education, Healthcare, G.R.O.W. (women's livelihood), and iSTORYA (youth storytelling) - and is backed by partners including ADB SCF, MSF, Tzu Chi, Eric Kayser, the Canva Foundation, LSEG, AXA, and PBSP. 



We are looking for a Digital Marketing Strategist / Social Media Manager to help us tell that story more powerfully - growing our donor and volunteer community, strengthening our brand across the U.S. and Philippine arms, and translating our on-theground impact into content that moves people to act. 



WHY PROJECT PEARLS 

 

• Help tell the story of a 16-year-old grassroots organization that has grown into a globally recognized nonprofit. 

• Directly shape how the world sees the families, scholars, and mothers we serve. 

• Build a digital presence from a place of real impact while working closely with our founder and a lean, mission-driven team. 



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 

 

Digital Strategy & Content 

• Develop and execute an integrated social media and digital marketing strategy across our core platforms (Meta, 

Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube) to grow awareness and engagement for Project PEARLS' mission and five program pillars. 

• Plan, create, and manage a regular content calendar - photos, short-form video, stories, and written content - that captures our programs in the field (Hunger Relief distributions, G.R.O.W. livelihood cohorts, iSTORYA storytelling sessions, clinic days, scholar milestones). 

• Manage day-to-day publishing, community management, and timely responses across our social channels. 



Campaigns, Community & Collaboration 

• Support donor and campaign communications, including seasonal fundraising pushes (e.g., our annual Christmas "Adopt a Family" campaign) and partner cause-marketing collaborations. 

• Collaborate remotely with the Founder/CEO, Chief of Staff, and program teams in the Philippines to ensure messaging is accurate and mission-aligned, while also supporting content and campaigns aimed at our U.S. donor base. 



Performance, Brand & Innovation 

• Track and report on social and digital performance metrics, using data to refine content strategy and demonstrate ROI to leadership and the Board. 

• Maintain brand consistency across all digital touchpoints, including the website,
, and social presence. 

• Stay current on nonprofit digital marketing trends and platform changes, bringing new ideas to the team. 

 

QUALIFICATIONS 

 

Experience & Track Record 

• 3-5+ years of experience in social media strategy, digital marketing, or content marketing - nonprofit or mission driven experience strongly preferred. 

• A portfolio or track record showing measurable growth in audience, engagement, or fundraising results from social/digital campaigns. 


 

• Strong writing, storytelling, and editing skills, with the ability to adapt tone for different platforms and audiences (donors, volunteers, scholars' families, corporate partners). Tools & Audience 

• Hands-on comfort with content and design tools (e.g., Canva, basic video editing) and social scheduling/analytics tools (e.g., Meta Business Suite, Hootsuite, Sprout Social, Google Analytics). 

• Comfortable creating content that resonates with both Philippine audiences and our U.S.-based donor community, given our dual-registered structure. Work Style & Mission Alignment 

• Reliable home internet setup, own laptop, and a self-starter mindset - you'll work independently and async with a lean, distributed team (Manila, San Francisco, Hawaii) and can juggle multiple concurrent campaigns. 

• Genuine alignment with Project PEARLS' mission and community-first approach. 



HOW TO APPLY 



 Us Now:  

Please include your resume, a brief cover note, and 2-3 examples of social/digital work you're proud of (links or files).

title: E-Commerce & Social Commerce Manager
description:
Help Us Build Something From the Ground Up



We’re looking for a creative, results-driven E-Commerce & Social Commerce Manager to help build and grow our Shopify and TikTok Shop presence.



Both platforms are essentially a blank slate right now. They are ready for someone to come in, bring their ideas, put their own mark on the stores, and help build them into something that stands out.



This is an opportunity for someone who doesn’t just want to maintain an existing store. You’ll have the opportunity to help shape what these stores become.



We’re looking for someone who understands what makes Shopify stores convert, what makes TikTok Shop work, and how to turn products into content that gets attention and drives sales.



What You’ll Do



* Take ownership of our Shopify store and help develop its overall look, feel, organization, and customer experience

* Build and optimize our TikTok Shop

* Develop product presentation, collections, merchandising, and storefront strategy

* Optimize product listings, titles, descriptions, images, pricing, and other elements that can improve conversion

* Identify opportunities to make our products and storefronts stand out from competitors

* Stay current on TikTok Shop trends, features, algorithms, and best practices

* Develop strategies for increasing traffic, engagement, and sales

* Research competitors and identify successful products, content styles, and marketing strategies

* Work with content creators and TikTok affiliates to promote products

* Help develop promotions, campaigns, and product launches

* Analyze store performance and recommend improvements based on sales and customer behavior

* Work closely with our design team to make sure products are presented effectively

* Help build a consistent brand experience across Shopify, TikTok, and social media



Instagram Experience Is a Big Plus



We’d love someone who also understands Instagram, including:



* Reels

* Instagram Shop

* Product tagging

* Organic content strategy

* Growing engagement

* Working with creators/influencers

* Turning products into content people actually want to watch and share



Experience with TikTok + Instagram together is especially valuable because we want to build a social presence—not just list products.



What We’re Looking For



Required:



* Hands-on experience with Shopify

* Hands-on experience with TikTok Shop

* Strong understanding of e-commerce and online consumer behavior

* Ability to optimize product listings and storefronts

* Strong attention to detail

* Creative mindset with an eye for trends and presentation

* Ability to look at data and make decisions based on performance

* Self-motivated and able to work independently



Strong Plus:



* Instagram/Instagram Shop experience

* TikTok affiliate experience

* Experience recruiting or managing content creators

* Experience with print-on-demand or apparel

* Experience with fashion, streetwear, boutique, or lifestyle brands

* Experience with Shopify marketing,
, or paid advertising

* Experience creating or directing short-form video content



This Is a Build, Not Just a Management Job



Our Shopify and TikTok stores are a blank canvas.



We’re looking for someone who sees that as an opportunity.



You’ll have room to bring your ideas, experiment with different strategies, improve the customer experience, develop the stores’ identities, and ultimately put your mark on the business.



We want someone who can look at our stores and say:



“Here’s what I would do, here’s why I would do it, and here’s how I’m going to make it happen.”



You should be comfortable taking initiative rather than waiting to be told what to do.



If you’re someone who spends time on TikTok and Instagram, understands why certain products and videos take off, follows e-commerce trends, and gets excited about building something from the ground up, this could be a great opportunity for you.



How to Apply



Please send:



1. A brief introduction about yourself

2. Your experience with Shopify and TikTok Shop

3. Examples of Shopify stores or TikTok Shops you have worked on

4. Examples of social media accounts you have managed, if applicable

5. A description of what you believe makes a Shopify/TikTok Shop successful

6. Your availability and desired hourly rate or monthly salary



Please include examples of your previous work whenever possible.

title: DM Setter - Ecommerce Advisory & Coaching
description:
At OOAK Advisory, we help e-commerce operators scale to 8 figures by installing proven systems across advertising, supply chain, team building, and brand. Alongside the advisory work, we run coaching and mastermind programs, our founders' personal brands, and our own e-commerce brands.



Almost every client we have started as a conversation in the DMs. Right now, there are more of those conversations coming in than we can answer, and the ones nobody gets to are revenue we never see.



We're hiring a DM Setter to own that inbox and turn conversations into booked calls for our closer and founders.



Key Responsibilities

- Work every inbound DM, comment, story reply, and new follow that comes off our content

- Run cold outreach to e-commerce founders and operators, at volume, without sounding like a template

- Send from both the OOAK brand account and our founders' personal accounts

- Qualify against our criteria and book only the calls that fit

- Follow up on schedule; most calls get booked on the third or fourth message, not the first

- Track and report conversations opened, reply rate, calls booked, and show rate every week



Requirements

- 2+ years setting appointments or running DM outreach with real numbers behind it

- Excellent written English, natural and conversational, no stiff scripts and no hype

- Fluent on Instagram and clear on what makes a founder reply instead of leaving you on seen

- Organised to the point of boring; every conversation tracked, every follow-up on the day you said

- Self-directed, chases their own follow-ups and hits their own targets



Bonus Points

- High ticket experience; a five-figure decision is a different conversation than a $49 product

- Background in or around e-commerce, DTC, or paid media

- You've set up a coaching, consulting, or agency offer



What We Offer

- Fixed salary of $900–$1,200/month depending on experience, paid on time, every month

- 40 hours per week, remote and flexible

- Real training on our offer, our qualification criteria, and our scripts

- Direct access to founders, no layers

- A growth path into closing; the setter seat is the entry point into our sales team



Not the Right Fit: This is not a copy-paste blasting role. We're looking for someone who treats the inbox like a pipeline, not a chore, and who would rather book 5 calls that show up than 15 that waste everyone's time.



How to Apply: Send the following to 

- Your CV/resume

- A short intro

- Three DM opening messages you'd send to an e-commerce founder doing around $200k/month who just posted about hiring struggles. Three different angles, not three versions of the same one.



Include the word "SETTER" in the subject line so I know you've read the post.

title: E-commerce/DTC Video Editor, For Ads (Full Time)
description:
Performance-focused. AI-augmented. Long-term.



We run paid media at scale for DTC and e-commerce brands across European markets, and we're looking for an editor who gets the why behind every cut, not just the how.



This isn't a role for someone who waits for a brief and assembles clips. We need someone who can watch raw footage and know instinctively which B-roll makes the hook land, who understands that the wrong cutaway kills a conversion and the right one doubles watch time. If you've ever paused an ad you liked just to reverse-engineer why it worked, keep reading.



The basics

Type: Full-time (40 hours per week)

Location: Remote

Compensation: [800-1,200] USD/month

Start: ASAP

Output: 3-4 finished edits per day

What you'll own

Edit short-form ad creative for Meta and TikTok: fast, punchy, conversion-oriented

Choose and sequence B-roll with intent. Every clip serves the hook, reinforces the claim, or deepens the emotional pull

Build visual hooks that stop the scroll. You know the first 1-2 seconds are the entire game

Cut UGC, founder, and testimonial footage into structured formats (Hook, Problem, Mechanism, CTA)

Generate AI video assets in Higgsfield and similar tools: realistic, on-brand footage that blends seamlessly with real clips

Produce modular assets that repurpose cleanly across placements and audiences

Non-negotiables

Proven DTC/e-commerce ad editing. You've edited ads that actually ran on Meta or TikTok for real brands. You understand pacing curves, attention drop-off, and how to build an edit around a conversion goal, not just aesthetics.



Intentional B-roll selection. You don't fill gaps, you amplify the script. You know when a reaction shot beats a product shot, and when on-screen text does more work than either.



Visual hook creation. You think visually first. You can concept and execute an opening that creates immediate pattern interruption, without leaning on the script to carry it.



Higgsfield + AI fluency. You're already comfortable prompting and generating realistic AI video, and you know how to make Higgsfield output that doesn't read as AI. We provide advanced internal training, but you need a real foundation to build on.



Strong English comprehension. Most scripts and voiceovers are in English. You need to catch nuance, not just words, so your edit rhythm matches what's being said and why.



Comfortable in Notion. We run briefs, trackers, and feedback through Notion. You don't need to be a power user, but you need to work inside it day to day without friction.



Nice to have

VSL or long-form ad formats for cold traffic

Direct response frameworks (AIDA, PAS, and similar)

Other AI video tools beyond Higgsfield (Kling, Runway, Pika)

Working knowledge of Meta ad structure: formats, ratios, placements

Who fits here

You think like a marketer, not just a creative. You care about what converts

You bring ideas and push back on a brief when you see a better angle

You ship final-ready work, not "almost there"

Fast iteration energizes you; it doesn't slow you down

You're driven and you work hard. You take pride in output and don't need to be chased

You want to be part of a team, not a solo freelancer. You communicate, share wins, and lift the people around you

You're honest and loyal. We'd rather hear the hard truth early than a polished excuse late, and we build long-term with people who do the same

What we offer

This is a long-term seat, not a gig. We invest in the people who commit to us:



Access to a premium AI tool stack (HeyGen, Higgsfield, ElevenLabs, and more), all on us, so you're never limited by what you can produce

Advanced internal training on our editing systems, AI workflows, and direct response frameworks. You'll get better at this here than almost anywhere else

A real growth path: clear room to take on more ownership, scope, and responsibility as you prove yourself

A team that values honesty and loyalty. We're direct with each other, we back the people who back us, and we keep the people who grow with us

How to apply

Send your portfolio (3-5 ad edits you're proud of, DTC/e-commerce strongly preferred) + expected monthly salary to my WhatsApp: 
If the requirements are not sent, you will be ignored.

Position Summary



The Customer Support Specialist provides responsive, accurate, solution-focused support to Engage customers while supporting the Customer Service team's day-to-day operational workload.



This position will handle a high volume of routine and moderately complex customer inquiries, process and follow up on claims, research order and fulfillment issues, review return and replacement requests, and ensure customer cases are properly documented and resolved.



The ideal candidate is organized, resourceful, comfortable researching issues across multiple systems, and able to independently resolve standard customer concerns while recognizing when a case requires escalation.



Key Responsibilities

Customer Support

Respond to customer inquiries through
, phone, chat, and other support channels.

Resolve routine and moderately complex customer service issues independently.

Assist customers with order status, shipping, product questions, returns, replacements, warranties, and general account concerns.

Research order and fulfillment issues across applicable systems.

Provide clear, professional, and timely communication throughout the resolution process.

Maintain accurate notes and documentation on all customer interactions.

Claims & Replacements

Review customer claims and supporting documentation.

File shipping, carrier, warranty, and other applicable claims.

Track outstanding claims through resolution.

Follow up with customers and internal teams when additional information is required.

Process approved replacements, returns, or other resolutions within established guidelines.

Escalate unusual, high-value, or exception-based claims when appropriate.

Returns & Operational Review

Review return and replacement requests for completeness and eligibility.

Research order history and supporting information before determining the appropriate next step.

Review RL and related operational queues as assigned.

Identify discrepancies or recurring issues and escalate them to Customer Support Level 2 or management.

Assist with maintaining organized and accurate customer service records.

Queue Management

Monitor assigned customer service queues and maintain timely responses.

Assist with reviewing and routing unassigned tickets as needed.

Prioritize urgent customer issues appropriately.

Maintain ownership of assigned cases through resolution rather than unnecessarily transferring tickets.

Help prevent aging tickets and unresolved follow-ups.

Escalation & Team Support

Escalate complex customer issues to Customer Support Level 2 when additional authority, research, or judgment is required.

Escalate significant customer experience concerns or unusual situations to management.

Follow established escalation procedures rather than automatically escalating routine issues.

Support the Customer Support Level 2 and Senior Manager during periods of increased volume.

Provide backup coverage across Customer Service functions as needed.

Decision-Making Expectations



This role is expected to independently resolve standard customer issues within established company policies and approval thresholds.



The Customer Support Specialist should be able to determine:

What can be resolved independently.

When additional research is required.

When a claim should be filed.

When a replacement, return, or other standard resolution is appropriate.

When an issue requires Level 2 review.

When a situation represents a larger customer experience or operational concern requiring management attention.



The goal is not simply to respond to tickets, but to own customer issues through resolution whenever possible.



Performance Expectations

Performance will be evaluated based on a combination of productivity, quality, accuracy, and customer experience, including:



Ticket volume and productivity.

First response and resolution times.

Ticket backlog and aging.

Quality and accuracy of responses.

Claims processing accuracy and turnaround time.

Proper escalation practices.

Customer satisfaction.

Documentation quality.

Attendance and reliability.

Ability to independently manage assigned workload.

Qualifications

Previous customer service, e-commerce, retail, or support experience preferred.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.

Comfortable researching customer and order issues across multiple systems.

Ability to follow established procedures while using good judgment when situations fall outside standard workflows.

Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Comfortable handling customer complaints and difficult conversations professionally.

Dependable and able to work independently while remaining collaborative with the broader team.



Experience with Shopify, customer service/ticketing platforms, shipping carriers, fulfillment systems, warranty claims, or e-commerce operations is a plus.



Important Remote Work Requirements

Please review these requirements carefully before applying. These requirements are mandatory and are not negotiable for this position.



This is a remote role that requires regular use of Google Meet with video/camera enabled, company-required
 tracking software, and company-issued equipment for work purposes.



Applicants must be comfortable and willing to:



Participate on camera during required Google Meet meetings, trainings, coaching sessions, one-on-ones, and other designated meetings.



Use company-required time, activity, and/or productivity tracking software during working hours in accordance with company policy.



Perform company work using company-issued/approved equipment as required.



These are conditions of the position, not optional preferences. If you are not comfortable or willing to meet these requirements, please do not apply.



By applying for this position, candidates acknowledge that they have reviewed these requirements and are willing to comply with them if hired.

title: Recruiter
description:
Summary

SpartanX is seeking a driven and results-oriented Recruiter to attract, engage, and hire top talent across multiple departments and U.S. markets. This role manages the full recruiting lifecycle - from sourcing and screening through interview coordination and hiring recommendations. The ideal candidate is proactive, organized, and committed to

finding the right people, not simply filling positions.



What You'll Do

• Manage full-cycle recruiting for assigned positions.

• Source qualified candidates through job boards, social media, networking, referrals, and other recruiting channels.

• Review resumes and evaluate candidates against position requirements.

• Conduct phone screens and initial candidate assessments.

• Coordinate interviews with hiring managers and operational leaders.

• Maintain consistent candidate communication throughout the hiring process.

• Extend verbal offers and coordinate with HR and onboarding teams.

• Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.

• Partner with hiring managers to understand staffing priorities and position requirements.

• Develop sourcing strategies for difficult-to-fill roles.

• Maintain accurate ATS records, recruiting reports, and hiring metrics.

• Create and maintain effective job advertisements.



Qualifications

• 1-3 years of recruiting or talent acquisition experience preferred.

• Full-cycle recruiting experience preferred.

• Strong sourcing, interviewing, and candidate assessment skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong organization and time-management skills.

• Ability to manage multiple open requisitions simultaneously.

• Experience using applicant tracking systems (ATS).

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and Google Workspace.

• Ability to work independently while partnering effectively with hiring managers.



Preferred Qualifications

• Recruiting experience in solar, construction, electrical, or skilled trades.

• Experience recruiting both hourly and salaried positions.

• Experience with Indeed, LinkedIn Recruiter, ZipRecruiter, or similar sourcing platforms.

• Experience with Rippling ATS or HRIS.

• Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.



What We Offer

• Competitive compensation based on experience.

• Performance-based bonus opportunities.

• Career growth within a growing solar company.

• Team-focused culture built on accountability, professionalism, and operational excellence.

• Opportunity to directly impact company growth by hiring exceptional talent.

• Ongoing training and professional development.



Why SpartanX?

Great companies are built by great people. As a Recruiter at SpartanX, you'll play a critical role in identifying top talent, building high-performing teams, and helping shape the future of the organization. If you're competitive, relationship-driven, and passionate about connecting great people with great opportunities, we'd love to hear from you.



Apply here: 



Solar Done Right.

title: AI Automation & Operations VA / Technical VA
description:
# AI Automation & Operations VA / Technical VA



**Company:** Capital Revenue Systems

**Location:** Philippines — Remote

**Pay:** **$5–$6 USD per hour**

**Hours:** Part-time to start, with potential for more hours

**Start:** ASAP

**Position:** Long-term



## About the Position



Capital Revenue Systems is a new AI business, and I am looking for a **very experienced AI Automation & Operations VA / Technical VA** who can help me get the business up and running **ASAP**.



I am a business-focused owner and I am **not highly technical or computer savvy**. I need someone who can take ownership of the technical and operational side of the business and help build the systems necessary to launch.



**This is NOT a basic virtual assistant position.**



I am looking for someone who understands **AI, automation, business software, CRM systems, integrations, and online business operations.**



The right person should be able to look at what the business needs, recommend the right tools, set everything up, connect the systems, automate processes, test everything, and explain it to me in simple terms.



## Your Main Goal



Your primary goal will be:



**Help me get Capital Revenue Systems fully operational and ready to launch as quickly as possible.**



You will help build the systems that allow me to focus on running and growing the business rather than trying to figure out all the technology myself.



## Responsibilities



You will be responsible for helping with:



* Researching the best AI tools for the business

* Recommending the software and systems we need

* Setting up business software and accounts

* Setting up and managing our CRM

* Building lead-capture systems

* Building lead-management systems

* Creating automated lead follow-up

* Setting up
 and communication systems

* Setting up scheduling and calendar systems

* Organizing Google Workspace

* Creating forms and databases

* Building AI-powered workflows

* Creating automations between different software

* Connecting applications and integrations

* Using APIs and webhooks when necessary

* Testing all systems

* Troubleshooting technical problems

* Creating SOPs and documentation

* Organizing business processes

* Finding ways to use AI to save time and increase productivity

* Continuously improving our systems



## AI & Software Experience



You should have hands-on experience with several of the following:



* ChatGPT / OpenAI

* Claude

* Gemini

* Zapier

* 

* n8n

* GoHighLevel

* HubSpot

* Google Workspace

* Gmail

* Google Sheets

* Google Drive

* Airtable

* Notion

* Calendly

* AI agents

* APIs

* Webhooks

* CRM automation

*
 automation

* Lead-generation automation



**You do not need to know every platform listed above.**



What matters most is that you understand **how systems work together and how to build useful business automations.**



## The Person I Am Looking For



I want someone who is **very experienced, proactive, dependable, and able to work independently.**



I don't want someone who needs me to explain every technical step.



For example, if I tell you:



> "I want a system that captures new leads, puts them into the CRM, organizes them, automatically follows up with them, and alerts me when I need to contact them."



You should be able to figure out **how to build that system.**



You should be able to research the available tools, recommend the best solution, set it up, test it, and explain it to me.



### I want someone who says:



**"Here is what I recommend. Here is why. And here is how I will build it."**



Not:



**"Tell me exactly what to do."**



## Required Skills



### 1. AI & Automation Skills



Must have hands-on experience with AI tools and automation platforms such as ChatGPT/OpenAI, Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar systems.



### 2. Technical & Problem-Solving Skills



Must be comfortable setting up software, connecting systems, working with CRMs, integrations, APIs/webhooks, and troubleshooting technical problems independently.



### 3. Initiative & Business Systems Skills



Must be proactive and able to look at a business process, recommend the right technology, build the system, test it, and document it without needing step-by-step instructions.



## First 30 Days



### Week 1 — Learn & Plan



* Learn about Capital Revenue Systems

* Understand the business model

* Identify the systems needed for launch

* Research the best tools

* Recommend the technology stack

* Create a prioritized implementation plan



### Week 2 — Build



Begin setting up:



* CRM

* Lead management

*

* Calendar/scheduling

* Forms

* Google Workspace

* AI tools

* Automation platforms

* Other essential business systems



### Week 3 — Automate



* Connect the systems

* Build automated workflows

* Create lead follow-up

* Build AI-assisted processes

* Test integrations

* Troubleshoot problems



### Week 4 — Organize & Launch



* Finish critical systems

* Test the entire workflow

* Create SOPs

* Document the systems

* Create simple instructions for me

* Identify remaining problems

* Recommend the next systems we should build

* Help prepare the business for launch



## Qualifications



**Required:**



* Significant experience as a VA, Technical VA, Automation Specialist, or similar role

* Strong AI experience

* Strong automation experience

* Excellent computer skills

* Strong English communication

* Excellent problem-solving ability

* Able to work independently

* Able to learn new technology quickly

* Reliable internet connection

* Reliable communication

* Strong attention to detail



**Preferred:**



* Experience building AI-powered business systems

* CRM implementation experience

* Zapier, Make, or n8n experience

* GoHighLevel or HubSpot experience

* API/webhook experience

* Experience working with entrepreneurs or startups

* Experience creating SOPs

* Experience with AI agents

* Experience connecting multiple software platforms



## Compensation



**$5–$6 USD per hour**



The starting rate will depend on your experience and demonstrated skills.



This is intended to be a **long-term position**.



As you demonstrate that you can take ownership, build systems independently, solve problems, and help the company grow, there may be opportunities for:



* More hours

* Increased responsibilities

* Pay increases

* Long-term advancement within the company



## How to Apply



Please provide:



1. Your name and location in the Philippines

2. Years of experience

3. Your experience with AI

4. The AI tools you use

5. The automation platforms you use

6. Three examples of automations or systems you have personally built

7. The most complicated automation you have built

8. Examples, screenshots, portfolio, or Loom videos of your work

9. Your desired hourly rate

10. Your availability

11. Hours available per week

12. Your time zone

13. Your experience working directly with business owners

14. Why you believe you are the right person to help launch Capital Revenue Systems



## IMPORTANT APPLICATION QUESTION



**If you were hired by Capital Revenue Systems tomorrow, what would you do during your first 7 days to help get the business operational and ready to launch ASAP?**



Please give specific details.



I want to see how you think, how you solve problems, and whether you can take initiative.



## Paid Trial



The strongest applicants may be asked to complete a **small paid trial project** before being hired.



I am looking for someone who can become a **long-term AI/Technical Operations partner** for Capital Revenue Systems.



If you are highly experienced, proactive, technically capable, dependable, and excited about AI and automation, I would like to hear from you.



**Please do not apply if you are only looking for basic data entry, customer service, administrative work, or simple VA tasks.**

title: Marketing & Leads Coordinator
description:
Job Type: Full-Time | Remote

Schedule:Monday–Friday | Hours aligned with U.S. Eastern Time

Compensation:$3.00–$5.00 USD/hour, based on experience

Start Date: ASAP



PLEASE READ THIS ENTIRE POST BEFORE APPLYING. Applications that do not follow the instructions at the bottom will not be considered.**



About STEAMUP Academy



STEAMUP Academy is a growing educational organization based in Orlando, Florida. We provide hands-on learning experiences in Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics (STEAM) through our K–8 school and a variety of homeschool, afterschool, Saturday, camp, and enrichment programs.



Our brand is colorful, creative, engaging, and family-focused. As we continue to grow, we are looking for a talented marketing professional who can help us consistently tell our story, promote our programs, reach new families, and turn marketing activity into qualified enrollment leads.



About the Role



We are looking for a **Marketing & Leads Coordinator** to manage the day-to-day execution of STEAMUP Academy's digital marketing.



This is a hands-on role.



You will design graphics and flyers, create and edit social media content, manage our social platforms, create and monitor paid advertising campaigns, engage with our online community, prepare
 campaigns, support lead generation, and help ensure prospective families move from seeing STEAMUP online to becoming qualified enrollment leads.



You will work closely with STEAMUP Academy's Director and leadership team to understand current enrollment priorities and translate those priorities into effective marketing campaigns.



**This is NOT a position for someone who only schedules social media posts.**



We need someone who can design, create, publish, advertise, engage, track, and improve.





Key Responsibilities



1. Graphic Design & Creative Production



Create high-quality, on-brand marketing materials for STEAMUP Academy.



Responsibilities include:



* Design flyers, posters, banners, advertisements, and promotional materials.

* Create branded social media graphics and carousel posts.

* Design Instagram/Facebook Stories.

* Create graphics for program launches, enrollment campaigns, events, camps, and announcements.

* Design
 headers and newsletter graphics.

* Create digital and print-ready marketing materials.

* Update existing designs when program dates, times, pricing, or other information changes.

* Maintain consistency across STEAMUP Academy's colors, fonts, imagery, and overall visual identity.

* Organize marketing templates and creative assets for future use.



**Strong Canva and Adobe Photoshop skills are required.**





 2. Social Media Management & Content Creation



Manage STEAMUP Academy's active social media presence across agreed-upon platforms, including Instagram,
, TikTok, and other relevant channels.



Responsibilities include:



* Develop and maintain a monthly social media content calendar.

* Create and publish approximately **12–15 feed posts per month**.

* Maintain consistent Instagram/Facebook Story activity on agreed business days.

* Create content using photos, videos, program information, and other materials provided by STEAMUP Academy.

* Create Reels, static graphics, photo posts, carousel posts, program promotions, and other relevant content.

* Write engaging, polished captions.

* Include clear calls to action tied to enrollment, registration, events, or other campaign goals.

* Schedule and publish approved content.

* Repurpose strong content across appropriate platforms.

* Monitor content performance.

* Identify top-performing formats and topics.

* Stay current with relevant social media trends and platform changes.

* Recommend content opportunities based on performance and current trends.



Content should support STEAMUP Academy's enrollment, program, event, and brand-awareness goals—not simply fill the content calendar.



3. Video Creation & Editing



Create engaging short-form and promotional video content.



Responsibilities include:



* Edit short-form video for Instagram Reels,
, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

* Turn raw STEAMUP footage into polished marketing content.

* Add captions, text, graphics, music, transitions, and branding.

* Create program highlights, event recaps, testimonials, promotional videos, and advertisements.

* Edit longer-form content when needed.

* Repurpose existing footage into multiple pieces of usable content.

* Identify strong moments within raw footage that can be used for future marketing.



Experience with **CapCut, Adobe Premiere, DaVinci Resolve, or similar video-editing software** is required.



 4. Paid Advertising



Help STEAMUP Academy generate qualified leads through paid digital advertising.



Responsibilities include:



* Build and launch Meta/Facebook/Instagram advertising campaigns.

* Create ad graphics and video creative.

* Write ad copy, headlines, and calls to action.

* Create and manage lead-generation campaigns.

* Monitor campaign performance.

* Track leads generated by campaigns.

* Monitor cost per lead and other relevant campaign metrics.

* Test creative, audiences, copy, and campaign approaches.

* Identify underperforming campaigns and recommend adjustments.

* Optimize active campaigns based on available performance data.

* Coordinate campaign priorities and budgets with STEAMUP leadership.

* Maintain organized records of current and past campaigns.



Google Ads experience is a plus but is not required if you have strong Meta Ads experience.



5. Lead Generation & Enrollment Support



Marketing does not end when someone submits a form.



The Marketing & Leads Coordinator is responsible for helping STEAMUP maintain an organized marketing-to-enrollment pipeline.



Responsibilities include:



* Monitor incoming marketing leads.

* Ensure leads are properly captured in designated systems.

* Maintain organized lead lists and campaign-source information.

* Monitor lead status when appropriate.

* Respond to initial digital inquiries using approved information.

* Engage with prospective families through social media comments and DMs.

* Answer routine program questions using approved information.

* Identify qualified enrollment inquiries.

* Refer qualified leads to the appropriate STEAMUP team member for direct enrollment follow-up.

* Provide the Director/program team with clear lead reports.

* Identify leads that have not received appropriate follow-up.

* Track which campaigns and channels are generating inquiries and enrollments when data is available.

* Recommend improvements to lead capture and follow-up processes.



**This position supports the enrollment funnel but is not the primary admissions or enrollment-closing position.**



The STEAMUP Academy team handles direct family enrollment conversations and final enrollment decisions.





6.
 Marketing



Support STEAMUP Academy's
 marketing and lead-nurture strategy.



Responsibilities include:



* Create approximately **2–3
 newsletters per month**.

* Write newsletter and promotional
 copy.

* Design branded
 content.

* Include relevant calls to action.

* Prepare
s for distribution through STEAMUP's
 marketing platform.

* Support enrollment, program, event, promotion, and announcement
s.

* Assist with
 automation and lead-nurture campaigns.

* Maintain and update
 templates.

* Monitor available open, click, and conversion data.

* Recommend improvements based on performance.



STEAMUP currently uses ActiveCampaign, experience needed.



7. Online Community Engagement



Help STEAMUP build visibility and relationships within relevant online communities.



Responsibilities include:



* Monitor comments, direct messages, and social media inquiries.

* Respond to routine questions using approved information.

* Engage appropriately with followers and community accounts.

* Monitor potential enrollment inquiries and flag qualified leads.

* Identify relevant Orlando-area parent, homeschool, education, and community
 groups.

* Maintain participation in selected groups.

* Share approved STEAMUP programs, events, flyers, and enrollment opportunities when permitted.

* Adapt promotional copy to individual group requirements.

* Monitor STEAMUP posts within groups for comments and inquiries.

* Identify replacement or additional groups when existing groups are not effective.



Community engagement should feel helpful and authentic rather than spammy.



 8. Marketing Planning & Campaign Coordination



Work with STEAMUP leadership to translate organizational priorities into marketing activity.



Responsibilities include:



* Participate in regular marketing planning meetings.

* Develop and maintain a monthly marketing/content calendar.

* Coordinate marketing around:



  * Enrollment

  * Afterschool programs

  * Homeschool programs

  * Saturday programs

  * Camps

  * Events

  * School recruitment

  * Special programs

* Plan marketing campaigns ahead of program deadlines.

* Maintain organized marketing project lists and deadlines.

* Identify upcoming marketing needs before they become urgent.

* Recommend campaign ideas based on current enrollment goals.

* Coordinate creative assets across social media,
, paid ads, and print.





 9. Performance Tracking & Reporting



Marketing decisions should be based on results, not just how content looks.



Provide regular reporting that includes:



* Content published

* Social media reach

* Engagement

* Follower growth

* Top-performing content

* Paid-ad performance

* Leads generated

* Cost per lead when available

*
 open and click performance

*
/community-group activity

* Lead sources

* Enrollment conversions when trackable

* Key observations

* Recommendations for improvement

* Priorities for the upcoming month



The Coordinator should be able to explain what is working, what is not working, and what should change next.



Required Skills & Experience



Must Have



* At least 2 years of relevant digital marketing, social media, or content-marketing experience.

* Strong portfolio of professional graphic-design work.

* Advanced proficiency with **Canva Pro**.

* Strong working knowledge of **Adobe Photoshop**.

* Strong ActiveCampaign experience/ knowledge.

* Experience creating and editing short-form video.

* Experience managing business Instagram and
 accounts.

* Experience with Meta Business Suite and/or Meta Ads Manager.

* Understanding of lead-generation campaigns.

* Excellent written English.

* Strong copywriting and proofreading skills.

* Strong understanding of visual composition, typography, color, and branding.

* Ability to follow an established brand while bringing creative ideas.

* Strong organizational and time-management skills.

* Ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines.

* Comfortable learning new platforms and systems.

* Reliable high-speed internet.

* Ability to work independently during agreed U.S. Eastern Time hours.



Preferred / Big Plus



* Proven Meta Ads results.

* Google Ads experience.

* Experience with education, schools, camps, children's programs, or family-focused brands.

* Experience generating enrollment or registration leads.

* Experience with
 automation.

* Experience managing
 groups/community outreach.

* Experience with Eventbrite.

* Experience with YouTube/YouTube Shorts.

* Experience creating print-ready marketing materials.

* Basic landing-page or funnel experience.

* Experience tracking marketing leads through a CRM.



 You Are a Great Fit If You...



* Are both creative and analytical.

* Can turn a basic program description into a polished marketing campaign.

* Understand that a beautiful graphic that generates zero interest is not automatically successful marketing.

* Can create without needing step-by-step instructions for every post.

* Notice deadlines and upcoming programs before someone reminds you.

* Enjoy testing ideas and improving them based on results.

* Can manage several campaigns at once without losing track of details.

* Take feedback well and make revisions quickly.

* Communicate clearly when you need information or assets.

* Care about accuracy—especially dates, prices, program details, spelling, and calls to action.

* Understand that our ultimate marketing goal is to help more families discover and enroll in STEAMUP Academy programs.



What We Offer



* **$3.00–$5.00 USD/hour**, based on experience and demonstrated skills.

* Full-time, stable, long-term opportunity.

* Remote work.

* Consistent Monday–Friday schedule aligned with U.S. Eastern Time.

* Opportunity to take meaningful ownership of a growing educational brand.

* Variety—you will work across social media, design, video, advertising,
, and campaigns rather than doing the same task every day.

* Opportunity to see your marketing directly contribute to the growth of STEAMUP Academy and its programs.



How to Apply



Your application MUST include ALL of the following. Incomplete applications will not be reviewed.



Begin your application with:



"I Grow for STEAM"



Then include:



1. A brief introduction

   Tell us about your digital marketing, content creation, and graphic-design experience in your own words.



2. Your portfolio — REQUIRED



Please include examples of:



* At least **2 social media graphics, flyers, or advertisements** you personally designed.

* At least **1 short-form video** you personally edited.

* Examples of brands/social media accounts you have managed.

* Paid advertising examples, if available.

* Campaigns that generated measurable leads, registrations, enrollments, or sales, if available.



For campaign examples, tell us what you personally did and include results/numbers whenever possible.



3. Tools you use



Tell us your level of experience with tools such as:



* Canva Pro

* Adobe Photoshop

* CapCut

* Adobe Premiere

* DaVinci Resolve

* Meta Business Suite

* Meta Ads Manager

* ActiveCampaign

* Google Ads

* Other relevant marketing tools



4. Your availability



Include:



* Current time zone

* Availability during U.S. Eastern Time

* Earliest available start date

* Current internet speed



5. Resume/CV



Attach your current resume or CV.



Final Question



At the end of your application, answer this question in 3–5 sentences":



STEAMUP Academy has a new afterschool STEM program that needs 15 student enrollments. Walk us through what you would do during the first two weeks to market the program and generate qualified leads.



We are looking for practical thinking—not a textbook marketing answer.

description:
JOB OVERVIEW



Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage

This is a client leadership role, not just support.

SALARY

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

RESPONSIBILITIES

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE

title: Content Creator - marleys | Ecommerce Shoe Brand
description:
Content Creator — marleys



Part-time · Remote · Payment per reel/carousel produced (please see pricing below) · 6 reels and 2 carousels to start; if everything goes well, we can agree on a certain # of content per month. 



Monthly base — research, idea bank, meeting, shot list $40

Original reel (new concept, new edit) $10

Variant / cutdown (same footage, new hook and caption) $5

Carousel $6

Static / text post $3



About marleys



We make comfortable leather dance shoes in northern Portugal for social dancers — swing, salsa, bachata, and other dance styles. We've grown through in-person sales at dance events across Eastern Canada and we're building out our digital channels now.



You don't need to be a dancer. You do need to work inside a brand voice that's already defined rather than defaulting to your own.



This role has two parts: strategy and execution. You're not just a pair of hands — you're expected to bring ideas, and the ideas are expected to be grounded in what's actually working out there.



Part one — Strategy



Monthly research



Review what competitors and high-performing accounts in adjacent spaces are doing. Not a trend summary — specifics I could act on.



10-15 high quality entries on:

- Hooks that are working, transcribed as written

- Formats and ideas worth adapting

- Themes that are gaining traction, and ones that have gone stale

- Build the idea bank



Turn that research into a running database we can pull from — hooks, concepts, formats, references, each tagged so it's findable when we need an idea for a given pillar or product moment. It lives in our Notion so everyone works from the same source.



This compounds. By month four it should be the first place anyone looks when the calendar needs filling.



Monthly marketing meeting



- Collaborate with me (the founder) & the marketing coordinator to understand our content calendar for the upcoming month

- Ask questions, flag blockers to completing tasks

- Walk away with a content calendar that includes the idea, the visual reference, the text, captions, assets 



You'll see how your work performed. That feedback comes back to you in this meeting, because making content without knowing what landed is guesswork.



Part two — Execution



You're handed the social content calendar with the intent behind each slot — what idea we're going after, what it needs to do.



From there you make it:



- Write the hooks

- Write and set on-screen captions

- Edit video into finished reels

- Design carousels and static assets in Canva to our templates

- Write post captions in our voice

- Deliver sized per platform, ready to schedule



I film. You tell me what to shoot: each clip, the hook line, rough length, setting. I should be able to film a batch in one sitting without thinking about it.



You don't schedule or publish. You hand finished assets to the coordinator, who schedules them and tracks performance.



How the handoff works



1. Monthly meeting — you propose, coordinator plans

2. Coordinator hands you the calendar with the intent per slot

3. You look through our existing footage and see if there's already something there or if I need to film new content

4. If I film new content, you tell me what I need to film

5. You deliver finished assets for approval; revise as needed 

6. The marketing coordinator schedules and reports back — into next month's meeting



What you get

- An editorial brief. Our voice, our formatting rules, what we do and don't do, with examples of each

- A monthly working session with me (the founder) and the coordinator, plus performance data on everything you've made

- Visual direction. Reference and inspiration for how we're building the brand and visual identity, so the look is a shared decision rather than something you infer

- Canva templates and access to our Notion, where the calendar, brief, and idea bank live



What we're looking for

- Short-form video editing that feels native to the platform, not templated. CapCut or Premiere

- Canva fluency working inside existing brand templates

- Strong written English with a real ear for voice. You can hear the difference between a human hook and a generated one

- Comfortable working in Notion — the calendar, briefs, and idea bank live there and I need it kept current

- Genuinely curious about what makes content work. The research half of this job isn't a chore you get through to reach the fun part

- Reliable turnaround. Batches have dates

- Overlap with Eastern Time



On AI: use it. We do. But carousels that look generated, video with that AI-made look, and copy that reads like an unedited first draft are not what we're after. You're the judgment on top of the tool, not a pass-through for it.



On learning: if parts of this are new to you, say so. I'd rather work with someone sharp and curious than someone who overclaims.



How this starts



One paid trial batch of 6 reels and 2 carousels. We'll sit down and discuss a content calendar I've built, our existing content bank, and our visual direction & brand kit. You tell me what to film where needed. In a week's time, you deliver 6 reels, 2 carousel, and copy for all of it, plus five hooks you'd want to test and where they came from. Based on performance, we go monthly.





To apply



Please note: Generic AI responses will be automatically rejected. 



- Two short-form videos you edited. What were you going for, and did it work?

- Your portfolio 

- One carousel you designed for a brand.

- Pick any post on 
 Instagram and write a better hook for it. One line.

- Name one account you'd watch for ideas in our space, and one hook of theirs you'd steal.

title: Fleet Manager
description:
The Fleet Manager is responsible for overseeing the organization's fleet of vehicles

and equipment to ensure they are safe, reliable, compliant, and cost-effective. This

position manages vehicle acquisition, maintenance, repairs, licensing, fuel usage,

driver compliance, and fleet performance while ensuring adherence to company

policies and regulatory requirements.



Essential Duties and Responsibilities

? Manage the daily operations of the company's fleet of vehicles and equipment.

? Develop and implement preventive maintenance schedules to minimize

downtime.

? Coordinate vehicle inspections, repairs, and warranty work with internal

technicians and external vendors.

? Monitor fleet performance, utilization, fuel consumption, and operating costs.

? Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and local regulations, including

DOT, OSHA, and environmental requirements where applicable.

? Maintain accurate records for vehicle registrations, titles, insurance, permits,

inspections, and maintenance history.

? Oversee vehicle acquisition, replacement, disposal, and asset lifecycle

management.

? Negotiate contracts and pricing with vendors, repair facilities, leasing

companies, and fuel providers.

? Monitor driver qualifications, licensing, training, and compliance with

company safety policies.

? Investigate vehicle a
 and coordinate insurance claims and corrective

actions.

? Develop and enforce fleet policies and procedures.

? Prepare reports and analyze fleet metrics to identify opportunities for cost

savings and operational improvements.

? Manage fleet budgets and recommend capital expenditures.

? Handle the coordination of after-hours support as needed.



Required Qualifications

? Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Logistics, Transportation

Management, or a related field preferred but not required.

? High school diploma or equivalent required.

? Minimum of 3–5 years of fleet management or transportation management

experience.

? Experience managing commercial vehicle fleets preferred.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

? Strong knowledge of fleet maintenance and repair practices.

? Understanding of DOT regulations, FMCSA requirements, and vehicle safety

standards.

? Experience with fleet management software and GPS/telematics systems.

? Strong analytical and budgeting skills.

? Excellent organizational and time management abilities.

? Strong communication and leadership skills.

? Ability to negotiate effectively with vendors and service providers.

? Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel.

? Ability to analyze reports and make data-driven decisions.

? Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.



This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work

performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or

qualifications. Duties may be modified to meet the organization's operational needs.

title: Amazon Account Specialist – Seller Central
description:
Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Position



We are a growing U.S.-based Amazon agency managing approximately 100 brands across a wide range of product categories. We are looking for an experienced Amazon Account Specialist to join our remote team and help manage the day-to-day execution of our clients' Amazon accounts.



This is not a general virtual assistant position. We are looking for someone who already understands Amazon Seller Central, can work independently, and is comfortable identifying and solving problems inside active Amazon accounts.



What You'll Do



You will work alongside Account Managers and other Amazon specialists to help manage client accounts, including:



Creating and optimizing Amazon listings

Updating titles, bullets, descriptions, backend keywords, images, and A+ Content

Managing variations and parent/child relationships

Troubleshooting suppressed, stranded, inactive, and restricted listings

Opening and managing Seller Support cases through resolution

Monitoring Account Health and identifying issues that need attention

Reviewing FBA inventory and helping with replenishment recommendations

Troubleshooting FBA receiving and inventory discrepancies

Managing coupons, promotions, deals, and other Seller Central programs

Performing keyword, competitor, category, and listing research

Reviewing accounts for opportunities and problems

Coordinating tasks with advertising, inventory, catalog, and creative team members

Keeping tasks organized and updated

Following up until issues are actually resolved



For us, "done" means the change is live and correct on Amazon, not simply that a case was opened or a task was submitted.



What We're Looking For



You should have 2+ years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central experience and be comfortable navigating Seller Central without extensive training.



Strong candidates will have experience with:



Amazon Seller Central

Listing creation and optimization

Catalog troubleshooting

Variations

FBA

Inventory management

Account Health

Seller Support cases

A+ Content and Brand Registry

Promotions and coupons

Amazon reports and business data

Basic Amazon PPC knowledge



You do not need to be a dedicated PPC specialist, but you should understand concepts such as ACOS, ROAS, TACOS, Sponsored Products, keywords, bids, and search terms.



Who We're Looking For



We care as much about how you work as what you already know.



You should be:



Proactive. You notice problems and opportunities instead of waiting for someone to assign every task.

Detail-oriented. Small Amazon mistakes can have large consequences.

Resourceful. You research problems, work through Seller Support, and keep pushing until you find a solution.

Responsive. You communicate promptly and don't leave teammates or clients waiting.

Accountable. If you own something, you follow it through to completion.

Organized. You'll be working across multiple brands and priorities.

A strong written communicator. Clear English communication is important.

Comfortable with feedback. We move quickly and continuously improve our processes.

About the Role



We are a small but growing remote team, so this isn't a corporate environment where you only handle one narrow task.



You'll get exposure to many different Amazon businesses, categories, and problems. Strong performers will have opportunities to take on more account ownership and responsibility over time.



We value people who take ownership, solve problems, communicate well, and make the rest of the team better.



Schedule



This is a full-time, long-term remote position.



We offer flexibility in working hours, but you should generally be available for 1–3 hours of overlap with U.S. Eastern Time for team communication and meetings.



How to Apply



Please answer the following:



How many years have you worked directly in Amazon Seller Central?

What were your primary responsibilities?

Approximately how many Amazon accounts have you managed or supported?

Describe one difficult Amazon catalog, FBA, or account issue you personally solved. What was the problem, and what did you do?

Which area are you strongest in: catalog/listings, inventory/FBA, account health, PPC, or general account management?

What is your expected monthly salary in USD?



Please begin your application with the words "SELLER CENTRAL" so we know you read the entire posting.



We are looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term position and the opportunity to grow with the team.

title: Freelance Graphic Designer
description:
Location: Fully Remote

Commitment: Freelance

Experience: 2+ years in graphic design experience for DTC/E-commerce brands

Reports to: Head of Creative + Brand

Company: Thesis



About Us

The human brain is the most complex object in the universe, yet society has accepted one-size-fits all approaches to cognition. The “solutions” (think coffee, energy drinks, and even a friend’s rx) were mediocre at best and frankly, made no sense to us. So, we created Thesis, the world’s first customized nootropics company. If you’ve never heard that word before, it’s just a fancy way of saying brain supplements. In five years, most will be taking nootropics on the daily and chances are, they’ll be ours.



With an exceptional efficacy rate, the world has taken notice - we've raised over $14M in venture capital, garnered interest from leading neuroscientists and athletes, and established ourselves as an industry-leading brand. We partner with exceptional independent creative talent to help us share the gift of enhanced cognitive function with the world.



Who You Are



You have 2+ years experience in graphic design

You design using Figma - this is required; if you’re more familiar with Adobe Photoshop or Illustrator, that’s OK but you’ll be required to use Figma while working with us

You’ve worked on graphic ads (aka static ads) for DTC and E-commerce brands

You’ve produced high-performing graphics like offer ads, AI ads, before & after, testimonials, etc.

You’re fluent in English and are confident communicating on calls (both internally and externally)

You’re open minded and willing to learn

You’re able to take feedback and use your initiative to manage graphic revisions

You communicate proactively like telling a manager when you have a problem and your output will be delayed

You use Instagram/TikTok in your free time… sometimes you feel you spend a bit too much time on there - but at least you know the platform well!



What We Need



You’ll be creating the graphic ads that help drive our growth. This is a hands-on creative role where you’ll have the opportunity to experiment, move fast, and see your work reach a massive audience

Create high-performing graphic ads for paid social channels including Meta, TikTok, and YouTube, turning raw footage and ideas into content that grabs attention and drives action

Collaborate closely with our Creative team to bring new concepts to life, iterate on winning ads, and constantly find ways to make our creative better

Own your designs from start to finish, making sure every graphic is polished, on-brand, and ready to launch on time

Stay obsessed with what’s working! Keep a pulse on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and the broader paid social landscape to spot emerging trends, formats, hooks, and creative ideas before they become stale

Experiment constantly. Test new hooks, cuts, formats, storytelling approaches, and creative angles to uncover the next big winner.

Learn from performance. This isn’t just about making great-looking graphics / statics. You’ll see how your creative performs in the real world and use that feedback to make the next round even stronger.



How We Work Together

Collaboration: We’re a collaborative team that cares much more about the quality and impact of your work than where you’re sitting or how many hours you’re staring at your screen.

Slack: Our home base for communication, collaboration, quick feedback, and an appropriate amount of GIFs and memes.

Team Calls: Regular check-ins keep everyone connected and aligned, along with creative training and opportunities to learn from each other.

Team Hours: We ask everyone to have at least three hours of overlap each day so we can collaborate live when needed. Outside of that, you’ll have flexibility in how you structure your day.

Freedom + Accountability: No screen monitoring. No time tracking. No micromanagement. We trust talented people to do great work and hold themselves accountable.

Performance Matters: Ultimately, we care about making exceptional creative that performs at scale. You’ll have the freedom to experiment, learn quickly, and keep raising the bar.

To apply, please include a link to your video editing portfolio so we can see example work! We're looking forward to seeing your creativity in action and learning more about your approach to video editing.

title: Static Ad Designer – Meta Ads | AI-Native
description:
Part-Time | Remote | Opportunity to Become Full-Time



We are a successful UK supplement brand with an established presence on Amazon, and we're now preparing to significantly expand our direct-to-consumer business through Meta advertising.



We're looking for a talented Static Ad Designer to join our creative team and help us produce high-performing static ads for
 and Instagram.



This will initially be a part-time position, with the opportunity to move into a full-time role as we scale.



The Role



We're looking for someone who combines strong graphic design skills with AI-native creative skills.



You should be comfortable using traditional design platforms such as Canva and Adobe Photoshop, but we're particularly interested in designers who are actively using AI to improve and accelerate their creative process.



This could include using AI to:



Generate realistic product lifestyle imagery

Create unique backgrounds and environments

Generate models or lifestyle scenes

Create visual concepts that would be difficult to produce with traditional photography

Edit, extend or manipulate existing product photography

Develop attention-grabbing visual concepts

Rapidly test different creative directions

Turn ideas and briefs into finished advertising creative



We're interested in AI as a creative tool, not simply someone who can generate an image and add text over it.



What You'll Be Creating



Your primary focus will be producing static creative for Meta advertising.



This could include:



Product-focused ads

Educational ads

Problem / solution concepts

Ingredient-focused ads

Benefit-led creative

Comparison / "Us vs Them" ads

Testimonial and review-style ads

Native / organic-looking social content

Advertorial and editorial-style creative

Infographic-style ads

Promotional and offer-led ads

AI-generated lifestyle concepts

New variations of winning ads

Completely new creative concepts for testing



You will also be expected to take successful ads and produce multiple new variations, testing elements such as headlines, imagery, layouts, messaging and visual hooks.



We want someone who understands that Meta advertising is about testing creative at volume — not spending days trying to make one design perfect.



Who We're Looking For



Ideally, you will have:



Strong graphic design skills

Experience designing static ads specifically for Meta /
 / Instagram

Strong Canva and Photoshop skills

Experience using modern AI image generation and editing tools

A good understanding of direct-response advertising

An understanding of visual hooks and how to stop someone scrolling

The ability to work from a creative brief

The ability to create your own concepts rather than relying entirely on instructions

Strong attention to detail

Good written and spoken English

The ability to produce and iterate creative quickly

Supplement / Health Experience



We are particularly interested in designers who have worked with supplement, health, wellness or nutrition brands.



If you've previously created Meta ads for supplement brands, we would love to see them.



Understanding how to make supplements visually interesting — particularly educational, ingredient and benefit-led concepts — will be a major advantage.



AI Experience



We want someone who is genuinely AI-native.



AI is becoming a major part of our creative production process, so you should already be experimenting with AI image generation and editing rather than waiting to be taught how to use it.



We're open to whatever tools you prefer to use. What matters most is the quality of the final creative and your ability to use AI effectively as part of your workflow.



Position



This will initially be a part-time, remote position.



However, we are actively growing our Meta advertising operation and there is a strong opportunity for this to develop into a full-time, long-term role for the right person.



We're looking for someone who can become an important part of our creative team rather than simply completing occasional freelance design tasks.



How to Apply



Please include a portfolio or examples of your previous work with your application.



We would especially like to see:



Meta /
 static ads

Supplement, health or wellness advertising

AI-generated advertising creative

Product-focused e-commerce ads

Educational or infographic-style ads

Examples of different creative concepts you've produced for the same product



Please also answer these questions:



1. Have you previously created ads for supplement, health or wellness brands? If yes, please provide examples.



2. Which AI image generation/editing tools do you currently use?



3. Which design tools do you use regularly (Photoshop, Canva, etc.)?



4. If we gave you one supplement product and asked you to create 5 completely different static Meta ad concepts for it, what types of concepts would you consider?



5. Please send us the 3 examples from your portfolio that you believe best demonstrate your ability to create performance-focused Meta ads.



Applications without examples of previous work will not be considered.

description:
# Sales & Operations Specialist



**ClearCoast Cleaning LLC | Remote | Full-Time**



## About ClearCoast Cleaning



ClearCoast Cleaning is a fast-growing, family-run cleaning company serving residential and commercial customers throughout the Seattle area.



We are looking for a **Sales & Operations Specialist** to join our team and help us grow.



This is a hands-on role with two main areas of responsibility: **sales and operations support**.



You will be responsible for generating new business through cold calling and outbound prospecting, handling inbound leads, following up with potential customers, assisting with marketing, and supporting our Operations Manager with scheduling and cleaner coordination.



We are looking for someone who is **proactive, organized, confident on the phone, coachable, and motivated by results.**



## Sales & Business Development



Sales is a major part of this position.



You will:



* Make outbound cold calls to potential residential and commercial customers

* Maintain accurate notes and follow-up tasks in the CRM

You should be comfortable:



* Picking up the phone

* Starting conversations with new prospects

* Asking questions

* Explaining our services

* Handling objections

* Following up

* Hearing "no" without getting discouraged

* Asking for the opportunity to earn their business



We are looking for someone who can become **confident and effective on the phone**, not someone who wants to avoid sales calls.

* Answer calls, texts, and
s

* Assist with quoting

Speed and follow-through are extremely important.

* Property management companies

* Apartment communities

* Office buildings

* Schools

* Churches

* Medical offices

* Real estate companies

* Construction companies

* Multifamily properties

* Local businesses

The goal is to create **real business opportunities and revenue**, not simply make a high number of calls.

*
 campaigns

* Customer reactivation campaigns

* Lead-generation campaigns

* Building prospect lists

* Researching potential customers

* Assisting with promotions

* Organizing marketing information

* Helping test new marketing ideas



You do not need to be a marketing expert. You should be comfortable learning and executing marketing tasks.



## Operations Support



ClearCoast already has an **Operations Manager who owns the operations department**.



Your role is to support the Operations Manager with day-to-day execution.



You will:



* Assist with scheduling cleaning jobs

* Coordinate cleaner availability

* Communicate job details and special instructions to cleaners

* Confirm cleaners before scheduled jobs

* Help coordinate schedule changes

* Assist with finding coverage when necessary

* Communicate with cleaners regarding upcoming jobs

title: AI VIDEO EDITOR | $3,000/MONTH + PERFORMANCE BONUSES

Performance bonuses

Full-time remote role

Real creatives running on serious ad spend

Your portfolio matters more than your résumé. Show us that you can create. Show us that you can edit. Show us that you understand ads. We're looking for the best ones.

title: Social Media Coordinator
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a creative, organized, and dependable Social Media Coordinator to help manage the social media presence for three established brands: WhisperKOOL, Ultra, and CellarCool.

You will work closely with our management and marketing team to plan content, maintain content calendars, turn existing videos and images into engaging social media posts, write platform-specific copy, publish content, and manage our online communities. You will also review existing video content to identify opportunities for short-form reels and develop short-form video editing briefs that outline the footage to use, on-screen copy, and other direction needed for the video editor to execute each reel. 

We are looking for someone who can do more than simply post content. Strong organization, attention to detail, and communication are essential, especially when managing multiple brands with their own voice, messaging, and priorities. You should be comfortable following established direction, managing deadlines, and communicating with the team when you need an asset, approval, additional information, or clarification.

As you become more familiar with our brands, products, and audiences, we want you to become increasingly comfortable contributing your own ideas and recommendations. Over time, we want someone who can identify opportunities for stronger content, better engagement, and continued growth across our social channels.

Most importantly, we are looking for someone who wants to become a long-term member of our team, take ownership of their responsibilities, consistently produce quality work, and grow alongside our brands.



Responsibilities

Your primary responsibilities will include:

Create and maintain social media content calendars across three distinct brands

Qualifications

 Reels, YouTube Shorts, or TikTok

Tools & Skills

Schedule & Availability
