title: SOCIAL MEDIA VIDEO EDITOR (PRODUCTS/REAL ESTATE)
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a creative, dependable, and detail-oriented Social Media Video Editor to work with our marketing team and create polished short-form video content across three established brands: WhisperKOOL, Ultra Wine Racks, and CellarCool.



You will work closely with our Social Media Coordinator and marketing team to turn provided raw footage, product videos, photography, and detailed video editing briefs into finished social media content for Instagram,
, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube.



The Style We Are Looking For (EXAMPLE - 
)



Our brands have a polished, premium visual style. We are particularly interested in editors who have experience creating short-form content featuring:



Products

Architecture and interiors

Real estate

Luxury or premium consumer brands

Home design and lifestyle

Visually driven commercial brands

This role is not primarily focused on talking-head, podcast, influencer, or interview-style editing.



Many of our videos feature products, wine cellars, interiors, installations, and other visually strong footage. We want an editor who knows how to let that footage carry the story and enhance it through thoughtful pacing, clean typography, music, subtle motion, color, and restrained use of effects.



The finished content should feel clean, modern, sophisticated, and brand-driven rather than overly trendy, busy, or templated.



Our team will typically provide the source footage along with an editing brief identifying the footage or timestamps to use, messaging, on-screen copy, and other creative direction. Your role is to turn those instructions and assets into an elevated, platform-ready finished video.



Strong communication and reliability are important. If something in a video editing brief is unclear, an asset is missing, or you identify a potential issue with an edit, we expect you to communicate with our team rather than make assumptions.



As you become more familiar with our brands and content standards, we want you to become increasingly comfortable contributing creative editing recommendations of your own.



We are looking for someone we can work with long term who consistently produces high-quality work, meets deadlines, communicates well, and develops a strong understanding of our brands.



Responsibilities



Your primary responsibilities will include:



Edit short-form video content for Instagram Reels,
 Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, LinkedIn, and other social platforms

Turn provided footage into polished, visually engaging, platform-ready social content

Follow detailed video editing briefs that may include timestamps, messaging, on-screen copy, editing direction, and calls to action

Create clean, professional text overlays and typography that complement rather than overpower the footage

Select appropriate music and use transitions, sound design, motion, and graphics with restraint

Maintain a polished and consistent visual standard across content

Edit product-focused, lifestyle, educational, promotional, and brand-awareness content

Crop, reframe, pace, color-correct, and otherwise optimize existing footage for vertical short-form video

Create variations when needed for different brands, platforms, and target audiences

Understand and maintain the distinct visual identities of our three brands

Collaborate with the Social Media Coordinator and marketing team on feedback and revisions

Organize project files, footage, graphics, and completed assets so they can be easily accessed by the team

Complete projects according to established deadlines and content calendars

Recommend editing treatments and creative approaches as you become familiar with our brands

Assist with additional video and visual content projects as needed

Qualifications



Required Experience



At least 2 years of professional video editing experience

Strong portfolio demonstrating polished short-form video editing

Experience editing visually driven product, lifestyle, architectural, interior design, real estate, luxury, or similar brand content

Strong sense of pacing, composition, typography, visual hierarchy, and storytelling

Ability to create an engaging video without relying on excessive effects, fast cuts, captions, or visual clutter

Ability to take detailed creative direction and translate it into a polished finished piece

Strong attention to detail and consistency

Color correction and basic audio editing skills

Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines

Professional-level fluency in English with strong written and verbal communication skills

Reliable internet connection and a computer capable of professional video editing

Experience working collaboratively with remote teams

Preferred Experience



Creating video content for established brands or businesses

Product-focused social media content

Architecture, interior design, real estate, home, luxury, or lifestyle content

Premium or high-end consumer brands

Simple motion graphics and animation

Experience adapting horizontal or existing brand footage into polished 9:16 social content

Tools & Skills



Experience with professional editing tools such as:



Adobe Premiere Pro

Adobe After Effects

Final Cut Pro

CapCut or similar professional editing software

Adobe Photoshop

Adobe Creative Cloud

Canva

Google Drive / Google Workspace

Microsoft Teams or similar communication platforms

You do not need to use every program listed above. We care much more about the quality, taste level, and polish of your work than which editing program you prefer.



Schedule & Availability



This is a remote, hourly contract position working with a U.S.-based marketing team.



Hours will vary based on our current video editing and content needs. Contractors will have flexibility in when work is completed but will be expected to meet agreed-upon deadlines, communicate consistently, and be responsive during active projects.



There are no required daily working hours, although occasional availability for meetings, project discussions, or creative reviews during U.S. business hours may be needed.



Please include your current availability and typical turnaround time for video editing projects in your application.



How to Apply



Please include:



A short introduction about yourself and your professional video editing experience.

Direct links to 3–5 short-form videos you personally edited that best demonstrate the style we are seeking.

For your examples, we strongly prefer work featuring products, architecture, interiors, real estate, luxury/lifestyle brands, or other visually driven subjects.

A brief description of your specific role in creating each example.

The editing and design software you are most comfortable using.

Your current availability and typical turnaround time.

Important Portfolio Requirement



Please do not submit only talking-head, podcast, interview, gaming, or influencer-style videos as your portfolio examples.



Those editing skills can be valuable, but they are not the primary style of content we are hiring for.



We specifically want to see examples that demonstrate your ability to create clean, polished, elevated short-form content from visually strong footage.



If you have examples involving products, architecture, interiors, real estate, home design, hospitality, luxury goods, automobiles, or similar premium visual content, please prioritize those examples.



Applications that do not include relevant portfolio examples may not be considered.



Application Subject Line



Include the words "SOCIAL VIDEOS/REELS" in your subject line.



Quick Application Question



Choose one of the product, real estate, architectural, lifestyle, or visually driven videos you submitted above and briefly explain:



What did you do in the edit to make the finished video feel polished and premium?



Please keep your response brief. We want to understand your visual judgment and thought process as an editor.



Interview Process



Qualified candidates who advance through the application process will be invited to a live video interview with our team. A video interview is required before a final hiring decision is made.

title: Executive Virtual Assistant
description:
$5–$7 USD/hour | Long-Term Position | Growth Opportunity



We are looking for a smart, dependable, highly organized Virtual Assistant who wants to become a long-term part of our team.



We are not looking for someone who simply completes assigned tasks and waits for the next instruction. We want someone who takes ownership, follows through, thinks ahead, brings ideas, and helps us improve the way we operate.



You do not need to know everything when you start. We will train the right person. What matters most is that you are intelligent, resourceful, dependable, comfortable with technology, and able to learn independently.



Prior appraisal experience is NOT required. We can teach you the appraisal-related portion of the position.



Responsibilities



You will assist with:



Typing and preparing appraisal-related reports and documents

Answering incoming business calls

Communicating professionally with homeowners, lenders, attorneys, real estate professionals, and other clients

Scheduling appraisal appointments

Responding to appraisal bid requests

Negotiating fees and turn times within company guidelines

Managing
s, calendars, orders, files, and client follow-ups

Keeping track of outstanding items and following up without needing to be reminded

Helping organize and improve company systems and workflows

Using ChatGPT and other technology to improve productivity

Assisting with website, marketing, advertising, and business improvement projects as needed



Again, appraisal experience is not required. We are willing to train someone who demonstrates strong learning ability, attention to detail, initiative, professionalism, and reliability.



Schedule & Availability



This position requires consistent availability during U.S. Central Time (CT) business hours.



Work schedules will generally fall within one of the following shifts:



8:00 AM – 5:00 PM CT

9:00 AM – 6:00 PM CT

10:00 AM – 7:00 PM CT



The specific schedule will be determined based on company needs and discussed during the hiring process.



Because this position includes answering business calls, communicating with clients, scheduling appointments, and handling time-sensitive matters, applicants must be able to reliably and consistently work their assigned Central Time schedule.



Computer & Workstation Requirements



Because this position involves working with multiple programs, documents, websites,
s, appraisal software, and other systems at the same time, you must already have an appropriate workstation.



You must have:



A reliable computer capable of handling your daily workload

At least two computer monitors/screens that can be used together as one workstation

Reliable high-speed internet

A working microphone and audio setup for calls and meetings

A dependable backup plan for internet or power outages



A desktop computer plus a completely separate laptop that cannot function as a second connected display does NOT meet the two-screen requirement.



You must be able to work across at least two screens simultaneously from the same workstation.



Please do not apply if you do not currently meet this requirement.



We Want Someone Who Contributes



We do not want someone who does something a certain way simply because “that’s how it has always been done.”



If you notice a better, faster, more organized, or more efficient way to do something, we want you to tell us.



We want someone who:



Takes ownership of assignments from beginning to completion

Follows up without being asked

Notices when something still needs attention

Thinks ahead

Identifies problems and suggests solutions

Brings new ideas to the company

Researches better ways of doing things

Is comfortable respectfully recommending changes

Wants to help the company grow, not simply complete tasks



If you are given responsibility for something, we should not have to continuously remind you that it still needs to be completed.



We want someone who develops their own system for keeping track of responsibilities, deadlines, follow-ups, and outstanding items.



AI & Technology



You do not need to be an AI expert.



However, you must be comfortable learning new technology and figuring things out independently.



We may ask you to research ChatGPT, AI tools, automation, websites, marketing systems, software, or other technology that could help our business.



We want someone who can research it, learn it, test it, help implement it, and then come back and clearly teach us how to use it.



If you encounter something you do not know how to do, your first response should not always be, “I don't know how.”



We value people who are willing to research, troubleshoot, learn, and attempt to find a solution.



If you are carefully reading this job posting, use the exact subject line “Michael Jackson Is Dancing” when submitting your application.



You Should Be

Highly organized and detail-oriented

Reliable and consistent

Strong in written and spoken English

Comfortable speaking with U.S.-based clients by phone

Professional and confident

Able to work independently

A strong problem solver

Comfortable learning new technology

Able to follow instructions carefully

Proactive and willing to take initiative

Comfortable receiving feedback

Interested in a long-term position and growing with one company

Able to consistently work during your assigned U.S. Central Time schedule

Able to manage multiple responsibilities and follow-ups without constant supervision



Experience with customer service, executive assistance, real estate, mortgage, scheduling, ChatGPT, websites, marketing, CRM systems, or automation is a plus.



Appraisal experience is a plus but is NOT required.



Pay & Growth



Starting pay is $5–$7 USD/hour, depending on experience and demonstrated ability.



We plan to conduct a performance review after approximately 90 days. Strong performance, increased independence, and greater responsibility can lead to increased compensation and advancement.



We are looking for someone who wants to become an important part of the company over the long term.



How to Apply



Please answer each of the following questions:



Briefly introduce yourself and describe your work experience.

Describe your experience answering phones and communicating with clients.

Tell us about your experience with ChatGPT or other AI tools. Limited experience is okay.

Give one example of something you did not know how to do but successfully researched and learned on your own.

Tell us about a time you noticed something at work that could be done better. What did you recommend or change?

If you were assigned something that required follow-up several days later, how would you make sure it was completed without your manager reminding you?

Tell us about any experience with scheduling, negotiating, real estate, websites, marketing, or automation.

List the software and online tools you are comfortable using.

Describe your primary computer and workstation setup.

Confirm that you currently have at least two monitors/screens that can be used simultaneously as part of the same workstation.

Describe your internet connection and your backup plan for internet or power outages.

Which of the following Central Time schedules can you consistently work: 8 AM–5 PM, 9 AM–6 PM, or 10 AM–7 PM? Please list all that apply.

What hourly rate are you requesting between $5 and $7 USD/hour, and why?

Why are you interested in a long-term position?

Voice Recording Required



Along with your written application, please send a short voice recording introducing yourself and briefly discussing your work experience.



This position requires regular communication with U.S.-based clients by phone, so the voice recording will help us evaluate spoken English, communication style, professionalism, clarity, and comfort speaking.



Applications submitted without the requested voice recording may not receive further consideration.



Interview Process & Typing Test



Candidates whose applications appear to be a strong match may be invited to move forward to the interview stage.



If we d
 to move forward with you, we will provide a typing test that must be completed as part of the interview process.



The typing test is not required when initially submitting your application. Instructions will be provided directly to selected applicants.



Because a significant portion of this position involves typing, data entry,
s, documents, reports, and computer-based work, typing ability will be considered when evaluating candidates.



Professional References



Professional references are strongly preferred and may give an applicant stronger consideration.



If available, please provide 1–3 previous employers, supervisors, or long-term clients, including:



Name

Company

Your working relationship

 address

Phone number



Please only provide references who have given permission to be contacted.



If you are currently employed and do not want your current employer contacted, simply let us know.



Important:

Please do not send a generic copy-and-paste application.



We are looking for someone who reads carefully, follows instructions, communicates well, learns quickly, follows through, thinks independently, brings ideas, and genuinely wants to contribute to the growth of the company.



Before applying, make sure you:



Have read the entire job posting

Can work one of the listed Central Time schedules

Already have the required two-screen workstation

Are comfortable regularly speaking with clients by phone

Are willing to learn appraisal-related work

Have included your voice recording

Have answered all application questions

Have followed the special application instruction included elsewhere in this posting



If that sounds like you, we would like to hear from you.

title: Supply Chain Specialist
description:
Pixie is a US-based, fast-growing, mission-driven company creating products that improve the lives of women and families around the world. We believe in empowering our team members to grow professionally, pursue their dreams, and make a meaningful impact through their work.



We are hiring full-time team members from the Philippines for this role. Because we are a US-headquartered company, work hours for this position will directly overlap with US business hours (Graveyard / Night Shift in PH time). We are looking for a highly organized Supply Chain Specialist to coordinate purchasing, inventory, production, and shipments with our suppliers in China.



What You'll Do

• Prepare purchase orders, review supplier invoices, and track deposits, balances, and payment deadlines

• Negotiate pricing, payment terms, order quantities, and lead times

Qualifications

• Experience in supply chain, purchasing, inventory, production, or international logistics

• Experience working with suppliers or manufacturers in China

• Strong Google Sheets skills and familiarity with purchase orders, payment tracking, freight, and CBM calculations

• Excellent English communication, organization, negotiation, and attention to detail

• Proactive, dependable, and comfortable working independently



If this sounds like a good fit, we would love to meet you.



***  PLEASE SEND US A VIDEO (
) OF 5 MINUTES OR LESS ANSWERING THE FOLLOWING QUESTIONS:  ***



1. Introduce yourself and tell us about your supply chain management experience.

2. What software, spreadsheets, or systems have you used to manage orders, inventory, and shipments?

3. Tell us about a supply-chain problem you identified and how you resolved it.

title: Client SUCCESS MANAGER: $2,000 p/m
description:
Full-Time | Monday-Friday | PH Morning / US Evening Coverage



We are hiring Philippines-based Client Success Managers to support U.S. clients during evening hours, especially Pacific Time.



This is a client leadership role, not just support.



You will own the client relationship, keep clients clear and accountable, create momentum, prevent frustration, and escalate risks early.



This role is best for someone with excellent English, strong emotional intelligence, high ownership, and confidence handling high-ticket clients calmly.



Success is measured by retention, trust, communication, accountability, client momentum, and risk prevention.



SALARY



- Ramp / Trial CSM: USD 1,500/month base

- Certified CSM: USD 2,000/month base

- OTE: USD 2,500-3,000+/month with performance bonuses

- Paid twice a month via Wise

- Certification is performance-based, usually reviewed after 30-60 days, and requires consistent performance, quality-control review, and leadership approval



SCHEDULE



- Monday-Friday

- Full-time: 7.5 hours a day; 37.5 hours/week

- Core client coverage: 6 AM-12 PM PH time

- Split shifts are allowed

- Afternoons and early evenings are generally free

- Required team/training meetings may happen around 9 PM-11 PM PH time

- Occasional client calls may run up to 12 PM PH time when needed

- Final schedule will be agreed during hiring and must be sustainable long-term



ABOUT US



We help creators, beginners, coaches, and business owners grow and monetize online using short-form content, AI tools, strategy, coaching, and accountability.



We provide an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system that helps clients turn short-form content into audience growth, leads, and income.



We have worked with 4,000+ clients since 2019.



Most clients are U.S.-based, and many are age 45+, so patience, clarity, emotional intelligence, and professional English communication are very important.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run client kickoff calls using our onboarding framework

- Set clear expectations from day one

- Help clients understand what to do next and why it matters

- Keep clients accountable to action items and deadlines

- Follow up with stuck, quiet, inactive, or delayed clients

- Re-engage clients before momentum is lost

- Respond to client messages within 24 weekday hours

- Close loops and avoid dangling threads

- Handle difficult conversations calmly and professionally

- De-escalate frustrated or emotional clients

- Identify refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and satisfaction risks early

- Escalate issues quickly according to SOPs

- Keep clear notes in Airtable / CRM

- Coordinate internally when support or escalation is needed

- Support renewals, referrals, testimonials, and upsell opportunities when appropriate

- Join required trainings, daily team Zoom calls, and feedback sessions

- Once activated, host a weekly client-support call or own a similar client-success responsibility



CLIENT LOAD



You will ramp gradually.



The target for a Certified CSM is 40-50 active clients, depending on client complexity, program type, and client inflow.



When fewer clients are available, CSMs may support reactivation, offboarding, client check-ins, and legacy-client cleanup.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote role

- Payment: Twice a month via Wise, always on time

- Performance-based bonuses

- Clear path from Ramp / Trial CSM to Certified CSM

- Growth opportunity into leadership

- Supportive international team

- Daily trainings and team Zoom calls

- SOPs, support, and structure provided

- Work with creators, brands, short-form content, and AI tools

- Required tools paid for after the test month where applicable

- Afternoons and early evenings generally free, with required evening meetings



REQUIREMENTS



- Currently based in the Philippines

- Fluent, professional English

- Clear and easily understood verbal communication

- Strong communication and emotional intelligence

- Calm under pressure

- High ownership, follow-through, and reliability

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines

- Comfortable handling difficult, emotional, or high-ticket clients

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations

- Strong Airtable / CRM documentation habits

- Reliable internet connection and professional home setup

- Willing to use Hubstaff during working hours

- Able to work PH morning / U.S. evening hours

- Comfortable with split shifts and required evening meetings

- Able to manage up to 40-50 active clients once trained and certified

- Able to meet certification standards without heavy supervision

- Able to identify and escalate refund, payment, chargeback, cancellation, and client-satisfaction risks quickly



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success

- Account Management

- Coaching

- High-ticket programs

- Online education

- Social media monetization

- Content strategy

- Creator economy

- AI tools like ChatGPT, CapCut, or Submagic

- Working with U.S. clients



WE’RE THE RIGHT FIT IF



You’ll likely thrive here if you:



- Enjoy client-facing communication

- Stay calm when clients are emotional, frustrated, or confused

- Take ownership without needing to be micromanaged

- Follow through consistently and stay organized

- Want a long-term role with growth potential

- Can balance empathy with accountability

- Are comfortable working with U.S.-based clients

Schedule appointments while ensuring that the patient's "important person" (IP), such as a significant other or key individual in their life, is involved. - Team Collaboration: Work cohesively with fellow tea
mbers and office staff to ensure a smooth and efficient workflow. Foster a positive and professional environment for everyone involved.

You will be equipped with a detailed video curriculum, including step-by-step Loom videos and documentation, to guide you through handling phone calls and other responsibilities as we expect. Our training is designed to set you up for success by making sure you’re comfortable and confident in your role.



Compensation:



- Base Pay: The position offers a competitive base salary.

- Bonus Structure: In addition to the base pay, you will be eligible for performance-based bonuses:

- Bonuses for the number of outbound leads that you schedule who show up for their appointment.

- Additional bonuses for leads who attend with their "important person" (IP).

- Experience with CRM systems, scheduling tools, and
 platforms.

- Attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.

- Ability to work well in a team environment and manage multiple tasks effectively.

- A passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their quality of life.

title: Solutions & Communications Architect (Fractional Contract)
description:
Job Type: 1 Month — Full-time (4-week build). After that — Fractional, ~15 hours/week ongoing.

We need a senior architect to lead this. The first month is a fast-paced, full-time build to get a secure, working pilot live. After that, the role shifts to a lighter, ongoing part-time role (about 15 hours a week) to maintain and grow what you built.

A track record building AI-enabled workflows, case/work-management systems, or automated systems with audit trails

Solid knowledge of identity/access management, data protection, and least-privilege design

Comfortable using AI tools to help with analysis and design — but you check the work yourself

Bonus Points



Experience designing for users with very different tech skill levels

A history of turning unclear requirements into a safe, working pilot — fast

Confidence to say "stop" when something isn't secure or ready



You'll Thrive Here If You...



Would rather build the right thing slowly than the wrong thing fast

Take ownership of quality and security, not just "something that works"

Enjoy high-trust, high-autonomy work where you d
 when something's ready

Are comfortable with an intense first month followed by a lighter, ongoing role

You should be someone who thinks beyond the immediate ticket. You pay attention to details, investigate before answering, take ownership, and know how to read a customer situation.



What You'll Do

-Proven sales/retention/upsell experience. You can identify needs, make recommendations, overcome objections, and help close a sale.

-Resourcefulness. When the answer isn't obvious, you investigate rather than guess or give up.

You must also have reliable high-speed internet, a computer, and a headset suitable for professional customer calls.

-$5.50 USD/hour

-Regular weekend availability is required

In 5 sentences or fewer, tell us about your most relevant customer service and sales experience. Be specific about what you personally did.

Submit a voice recording of no more than 2 minutes.

title: Billing & Bookkeeping Specialist
description:
About the Company

ProTechtion IT is a healthcare-focused managed service provider (MSP) based in Orange County, California. We support medical practices and related organizations with Microsoft 365, infrastructure, security, and day-to-day IT operations. Accurate billing and clean books are essential to how we serve clients and run the business.



The Role

We are hiring a Billing & Bookkeeping Specialist to own our monthly invoicing cycle and QuickBooks Online bookkeeping. The core of this role is converting an accurate user (seat) count into correct monthly invoices, completing a one-time back-billing catch-up for prior periods, and then running the same process on a reliable monthly cadence.

This is a detail-heavy operations role. You will work from contracts, user lists, and service add-ons—not guesswork. Errors in user counts or missed back-billing directly affect cash flow and client trust.



Key Responsibilities

Monthly invoicing from user counts

● Collect and reconcile monthly user/seat counts by client from the sources we designate (agreements, admin portals, technician reports, or exports).

● Compare current counts to the prior month and the contracted minimums or included quantities.

● Flag additions, removals, prorations, and exceptions before invoices go out.

● Prepare and issue monthly invoices that match contracted rates, user counts, and approved add-on services.

● Apply credits, adjustments, and tax treatment correctly when they apply.

Back-billing (initial catch-up, then monthly)

● Complete a structured back-billing project for periods where invoices were incomplete, delayed, or based on outdated user counts.

● Document the period covered, the count used, the rate applied, and the resulting amount for each client.

● Issue catch-up invoices in a client-ready format, with a clear explanation of what is being billed and why.

● After the catch-up is closed, fold any remaining true-ups into the regular monthly cycle so back-billing does not become a recurring emergency.



QuickBooks Online bookkeeping

● Record invoices, payments, credits, and deposits in QuickBooks Online.

● Keep customer records, items/services, and classes or locations consistent with how we bill MSP contracts.

● Match bank and payment activity to open invoices; follow up on unapplied payments.

● Maintain an aging report and a clean accounts-receivable list.

● Support month-end close: outstanding invoices, undeposited funds, obvious coding errors, and a simple billing summary for ownership.



Process, communication, and controls

● Build and follow a written monthly billing calendar (count freeze date, review date, invoice date, follow-up date).

● Send invoices and polite payment reminders; escalate past-due accounts to ownership with facts, not opinions.

● Coordinate with technicians and account owners when a user count looks wrong or a service was added mid-cycle.

● Protect client and financial data. Healthcare clients require careful handling of any information you touch.

● Leave an audit trail: source count, invoice, QBO entry, and any exception notes.



What Success Looks Like

● Every active client is invoiced from a documented user count each month.

● The back-billing catch-up is completed, documented, and then replaced by a steady monthly process.

● QuickBooks Online reflects issued invoices and received payments without a pile of unapplied or uncategorized items.

● Ownership can answer “who owes what, and why” from QBO and a simple billing tracker.



Required Qualifications

● Hands-on experience creating invoices from usage, seats, licenses, or recurring contracts (MSP, SaaS, telecom, staffing, or similar is a strong plus).

● Working proficiency in QuickBooks Online: customers, invoices, payments, credits, bank matching, and basic reports (A/R Aging, Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet).

● High accuracy with numbers, dates, and named line items. You check your work before it leaves.

● Clear written English for invoice notes and client-facing billing explanations.

● Comfort working from spreadsheets and exported user lists.

● Ability to handle confidential financial and client information professionally.



Preferred Qualifications

● Prior MSP, IT services, or healthcare practice operations experience.

● Familiarity with Microsoft 365 licensing or per-user IT service billing.

● Experience cleaning up messy historical billing or doing a one-time AR catch-up.

● Basic understanding of sales tax rules in California (we will define what is taxable).

● Experience with payment processors commonly tied to QBO (ACH, card, etc.).



Position Details

● Type:  $500 a month guaranteed at around 40 hours a month. Back billing and Bookkeeping catch up paid at $10.00 an hour.

● Location:  remote for a candidate who already works independently in QBO.

● Schedule: Must be available around month-end and the agreed invoice-release window. The first 30–60 days include a concentrated back-billing project.

● Reports to: Company owner.

● Tools: QuickBooks Online, Microsoft 365 / Excel,
, and internal ticketing or shared folders as assigned.

Go to

title: Video Editor
description:
## Video Editor for Golf Content & Online Horse Course



We’re looking for a reliable, creative, and communicative video editor to help produce content for two separate projects:



1. Short-form golf content focused on player development and entertaining challenges

2. A professional online horse-training course



You may apply for both projects or specialize in only one. If you believe your skills are stronger for either golf/social-media content or educational course editing, please say so in your application.



### Project 1: Golf Content Editor



Our golf content will document the journey of improving as a golfer through practice, progress updates, lessons, competitions, and interesting golf challenges.



For now, the focus will be short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Once the channel reaches 5,000 subscribers, we plan to begin producing long-form YouTube videos.



Responsibilities include:



* Turning raw golf footage into entertaining short-form videos

* Creating a strong hook within the first few seconds

* Removing slow or unnecessary footage

* Adding captions, sound effects, music, zooms, graphics, and transitions where appropriate

* Highlighting progress, personality, competition, and storytelling

* Finding the most interesting moments within longer recordings

* Formatting videos correctly for each platform

* Helping develop repeatable video styles and content series

* Preparing for long-form YouTube editing as the channel grows



Experience editing sports, golf, challenges, personality-driven content, or short-form social media is strongly preferred.



### Project 2: Horse-Training Course Editor



We’re also creating a structured online video course with an experienced horse trainer. The course will teach students through demonstrations, explanations, and step-by-step training lessons.



Responsibilities include:



* Organizing raw footage into clear course lessons and modules

* Removing mistakes, pauses, repetition, and unnecessary footage

* Combining multiple camera angles when available

* Adding lesson titles, chapter headings, key points, and instructional graphics

* Improving audio quality and maintaining consistent volume

* Adding captions where helpful

* Using close-ups, slow motion, arrows, or callouts to highlight important techniques

* Maintaining a clean, professional, and easy-to-follow editing style

* Organizing project files and revisions carefully

* Creating occasional promotional clips from the course footage



Experience editing educational content, online courses, documentaries, or horse-related content is strongly preferred.



### What We’re Looking For



The ideal editor:



* Communicates clearly and responds consistently

* Meets deadlines and gives advance notice of delays

* Understands storytelling, pacing, and viewer retention

* Can follow directions while also contributing creative ideas

* Pays close attention to details

* Accepts feedback professionally

* Keeps files and projects well organized

* Has reliable internet and dependable editing equipment

* Is interested in developing a long-term working relationship



Strong communication is extremely important. We expect regular progress updates and direct communication whenever instructions, footage, or deadlines are unclear.



### Editing Skills



Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, or similar professional software is acceptable.



Helpful additional skills include:



* Motion graphics

* Color correction

* Audio cleanup

* Caption design

* Thumbnail creation

* YouTube and short-form content strategy

* File management using Google Drive or Dropbox



### How to Apply



Please include the following:



1. Introduce yourself and describe your editing experience.

2. State which position you want:



   * Golf Content Editor

   * Horse-Course Editor

   * Both

3. Explain why you would be a strong fit for that project.

4. Share 2–4 relevant portfolio examples.

5. List the editing software you use.

6. Tell us your typical turnaround time for:



   * One short-form video

   * One 10–20-minute educational lesson

7. Provide your preferred pricing structure: hourly, per video, weekly, or monthly.

8. Describe how you communicate progress and handle revisions.

9. Share your weekly availability and current time zone.

10. Begin your application with the word **“EAGLE”** so we know you read the complete posting.



Applicants who send generic or automated responses without relevant samples may not be considered.



### Paid Test Project



Shortlisted applicants may be offered a small paid editing test using our footage. This will help us evaluate:



* Communication

* Ability to follow instructions

* Creativity and storytelling

* Editing quality

* Turnaround time

* Organization and attention to detail



This opportunity can become consistent, long-term work for the right editor.

title: JOB TITLE: UK Debt & Insolvency Caseworker / Accountant – Creditor Negotiation and Bankruptcy Support
description:
JOB TITLE: UK Debt & Insolvency Caseworker / Accountant – Creditor Negotiation and Bankruptcy Support



We are seeking an experienced professional to review a personal and/or business debt situation in the United Kingdom and help develop the most appropriate way forward.



The work may involve negotiating affordable arrangements with creditors, reviewing company and personal liabilities, preparing financial information, and assessing whether bankruptcy or another formal insolvency option may be necessary.



Northern Ireland experience is strongly preferred, as its insolvency procedures differ from those in England and Wales.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Review personal and business debts, assets, income and expenditure

- Create a complete creditor and liability schedule

- Separate personal liabilities from limited-company liabilities

- Identify urgent debts, secured debts and priority creditors

- Review correspondence, statements and creditor demands

- Prepare realistic income-and-expenditure and affordability calculations

- Help draft professional letters and settlement proposals to creditors

- Assist with negotiating payment plans, reduced settlements or temporary holds

- Explain the likely consequences of bankruptcy and other UK debt solutions

- Identify which matters require a UK-authorised insolvency practitioner, solicitor or regulated debt adviser

- Prepare an organised case file for any formal insolvency consultation

- Maintain complete confidentiality and securely handle financial documents

- Provide a clear written action plan with deadlines and recommended next steps



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



- Demonstrable experience with UK personal debt, business debt or insolvency cases

- Strong knowledge of UK creditor procedures and debt-recovery practices

- Experience preparing statements of affairs, creditor schedules and affordability assessments

- Excellent written English and professional communication skills

- Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills

- Meticulous, confidential and non-judgmental

- Able to distinguish between administrative support and advice that legally requires UK authorisation



HIGHLY DESIRABLE



- Experience with Northern Ireland bankruptcy and insolvency procedures

- UK accounting, bookkeeping, debt-advice or insolvency qualifications

- Previous employment with a UK accountancy practice, insolvency firm, debt-advice organisation or creditor-negotiation service

- Experience with director guarantees, tax debts, Bounce Back Loans, VAT liabilities and dissolved or insolvent companies

- Existing access to a qualified UK insolvency practitioner or solicitor for regulated matters



IMPORTANT



This role requires genuine UK experience. Please do not apply if your experience relates only to US, Philippine or other non-UK debt systems.



The successful applicant must not claim to provide regulated legal, financial or insolvency advice unless appropriately qualified and authorised in the United Kingdom. Where necessary, you will help prepare the information required for review by a UK-authorised professional.



TO APPLY



Please answer the following:



1. How many UK debt or insolvency cases have you handled?

2. Do you have specific experience with Northern Ireland?

3. What formal qualifications or professional memberships do you hold?

4. Have you worked with personal debts, limited-company debts, or both?

5. Have you dealt with HMRC debts, VAT, Bounce Back Loans or personal guarantees?

6. Describe one UK case in which you helped arrange creditor settlements or prepare for bankruptcy.

7. Which parts of this work can you personally undertake, and which would require a UK-authorised insolvency practitioner or solicitor?

8. What is your preferred hourly rate and availability?



Please begin your application with the words “UK DEBT EXPERIENCE” so we know you have read the full post.



This may begin as a short-term assessment and case-organisation project, with the possibility of continuing work depending on experience and results.

About us



We are a growing UK-based accountancy practice building out a modern, remote-first finance team. We look after limited companies and owner-managed businesses, and we're expanding our services. - How we work with AI



We use AI to gain efficiencies, and we want someone who's comfortable doing the same - but who understands its limits and always checks the numbers. If you either refuse to use AI or over-rely on it without reviewing its work, this isn't the right fit.

Working hours

title: Accountant / Financial Reconciliation Specialist
description:
About the role



We are looking for a financially competent Accountant / Financial Reconciliation Specialist to help us carry out a detailed review and reconciliation of our financial transactions.



The main objective of this project is to go through our DCA and financial records, reconcile the transactions, and build a clear understanding of exactly what has happened financially — including identifying discrepancies, unexplained transactions, missing information and anything that needs further investigation.



This isn't simply a data-entry or bookkeeping exercise. We need someone who is comfortable working with financial information, asking questions, investigating transactions and understanding how the numbers fit together.



We estimate that the initial project will require approximately one full week (up to 40 hours) for someone to do the work properly.



What you'll be doing



Reviewing financial transactions and records within our DCA

Reconciling transactions and ensuring the figures make sense

Investigating discrepancies, unusual transactions and unexplained balances

Identifying missing or incomplete information

Categorising and organising transactions where necessary

Tracing transactions to understand where money has come from and where it has gone

Producing clear summaries of your findings

Highlighting anything that requires clarification or further investigation

Helping us get a clear and accurate picture of our financial position

Working directly with me to answer questions and resolve issues

How we'll work together



I'd like to have a 30-minute call with you each day during the project.



This will give us an opportunity to discuss what you've found, answer questions, agree on priorities and make sure you're heading in the right direction.



You should therefore be comfortable working independently but also communicating clearly and regularly.



Who we're looking for



We're looking for someone at approximately Accountant / Management Accountant level, or someone with equivalent practical experience.



You should have:



Strong financial and accounting knowledge

Excellent attention to detail

Experience reconciling financial transactions

The ability to investigate transactions rather than simply process them

Good understanding of debits, credits, balances and financial records

Strong Excel / spreadsheet skills

The ability to spot discrepancies and inconsistencies

Good analytical and problem-solving skills

Excellent communication skills

The ability to work independently and take ownership of the project

You don't necessarily need to be a fully qualified accountant. What matters most is that you are financially competent, analytical and confident working through a large amount of financial information.



Initial project



The initial engagement is expected to be approximately 1 week / up to 40 hours.



We are looking for someone who can give this their full attention during that period and properly work through the financial information rather than rushing through it.



Potential for ongoing work

title: Bookkeepper
description:
## Bookkeeper – Ocean World Travel



Ocean World Travel is an established UK travel business specialising in cruises. We are looking for an experienced, reliable and highly accurate **Bookkeeper** to join our team on a long-term basis.



The role will involve maintaining accurate financial records and supporting the day-to-day bookkeeping of the business.



### Main Responsibilities



* Maintain accurate bookkeeping records and financial transactions.

* Record and reconcile bank and credit card transactions.

* Reconcile customer and supplier payments.

* Monitor invoices, payments and outstanding balances.

* Maintain purchase and sales ledgers.

* Prepare regular financial reports and summaries for management.

* Assist with monthly management accounts and year-end information.

* Prepare information and supporting schedules for our UK accountant.

* Check transactions and investigate discrepancies or unusual items.

* Maintain organised digital financial records and supporting documentation.

* Assist with cash-flow monitoring and payment schedules.

* Help ensure transactions are correctly allocated and recorded.

* Support the management team with financial information and ad-hoc bookkeeping tasks.



### What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who is:



* An experienced bookkeeper, ideally with experience supporting a UK business.

* Highly accurate and detail-oriented.

* Trustworthy and comfortable dealing with confidential financial information.

* Organised and able to manage their own workload.

* Confident identifying discrepancies rather than simply entering figures.

* Comfortable working independently with regular communication with the UK team.

* A strong communicator with excellent written English.

* Experienced with accounting/bookkeeping software and Excel/Google Sheets.

* Proactive and willing to suggest improvements to processes.



Experience within **UK accounting, VAT, travel, retail, hospitality or another transaction-heavy business** would be advantageous.



### Important



This is a **long-term position**, not a short-term data-entry role. We are looking for someone who will become a trusted member of our team and develop a good understanding of our business and financial processes.



Accuracy, confidentiality and integrity are extremely important to us.



The successful candidate will receive training on our systems and processes. They will initially work closely with the UK team and, once fully trained, will be expected to manage their regular bookkeeping responsibilities independently.



Applicants should provide a CV and details of their bookkeeping experience, accounting software used, experience with UK businesses/VAT and their expected monthly salary in PHP.

title: Senior SEO Specialist
description:
Most agencies pay their best SEO roughly what they pay their average one. We built this role, and the entire hiring process behind it, for the top 20% of SEO specialists, and we pay accordingly. Every application is scored against a rubric, every claim is checked against your CV, and only people who can show real numbers reach the interview. If your results so far have been average, this will not be the role for you. If you are genuinely good and tired of being paid like everyone else, keep reading.



We are an SEO and digital marketing agency in Ireland. Our clients stay with us: zero client churn in the last eighteen months, organic traffic up 113% for one client, around 2,000 conversions a month for another. We are now growing the team behind those results, and the last person we hired through this exact process has become one of our best people.



How we work

Three things matter here, and they will matter to you every day in this role. The first is real results: we report numbers clients can verify, which is why they stay, and it is why your work will be judged on outcomes rather than hours or optics. The second is ownership: you run your accounts like they are your own business, and nobody asks you to route changes through a ticket queue. The third is straight talk: we tell clients the truth about what is working and what is not, and we expect the same honesty inside the team, including telling us when we are wrong.



What you will do

You will own client accounts end to end, from SEO strategy through execution. The day-to-day work covers technical audits, keyword research, on-page implementation, local SEO and Google Business Profile management. You will work in WordPress every day and implement changes yourself instead of handing them to a developer. We also expect ideas: when you look at a client, we want to hear what you would try next. We are an automation-first agency, so you will work with AI daily, and you will learn more here in six months than in three years elsewhere.



What we require (we check every one of these)

At least 5 years of hands-on SEO with results you can show us

WordPress plus basic HTML and CSS

Ahrefs or SEMrush, GA4, Google Search Console and Screaming Frog

A real local SEO and Google Business Profile track record

Strong written and spoken English

Hands-on vibe coding experience with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex





Bonus points

Knowledge of backlinks and off-page SEO, including link building and digital PR, is the biggest bonus of all. Experience with Google Ads or
 Ads, DNS and hosting setup, basic JavaScript or Python, an eye for design, or ecommerce SEO will also score higher in our process.



Pay and growth

We pay at the top of your local market, full-time and long-term, reviewed on results. We can pay at that level precisely because we only hire at that level. We do not publish a number because we pay for skill rather than titles: tell us your rate and show us the results that justify it. There is a genuine manager track as the agency grows, and when we say results over hours we mean it, because nobody here watches your clock.



How hiring works

The application takes about fifteen minutes and consists of a short profile, your CV and six scenario questions, with no cover letter. If your thinking stands out, we send you a paid test task. Pass that and you get a single interview with the founder, with no five-round panels. After that comes a 30-day paid trial before we both commit long-term.





How to apply

Apply at 
oagencydublin.ie/roles/digital-marketing-specialist



There is no
 application; everything goes through the form so every candidate is assessed the same way.

title: Project Management & Operations Lead
description:
## Department: Operations & Project Management



## Reports To: CEO



## Role Type: Internal Leadership Role



## Client-Facing: Limited, with periodic communication and check-ins required



## About the Role



Atmospheric Thinking is looking for a highly organized, experienced, and proactive **Project Management & Operations Lead** to serve as the central owner of projects across multiple companies, brands, internal initiatives, and external client accounts.



This role will be responsible for keeping projects moving, ensuring deadlines are met, coordinating team members, maintaining accurate project documentation, communicating updates, identifying blockers, and helping continuously improve how work moves through the company.



The ideal candidate should be highly experienced with **ClickUp**, comfortable managing large numbers of active projects at once, and confident overseeing teams of up to 20 people. This person will work closely with the CEO and team members every day to ensure that projects remain organized, responsibilities are clear, priorities are understood, and nothing falls through the cracks.



This role will not be fully client-facing in the traditional sense of frequent client calls or presentations. However, the Project Management & Operations Lead will support client communication, updates, check-ins, scheduling, documentation, and follow-up when needed.



The person in this role will also play a major role in keeping the CEO informed and accountable. They will maintain visibility into deadlines, approvals, missing information, overdue work, client requests, team blockers, and upcoming priorities.



## Key Responsibilities



### Project Ownership & Management



* Serve as the primary owner and coordinator for projects across multiple companies, brands, departments, internal initiatives, and client accounts.

* Manage projects from initial assignment through completion.

* Ensure every active project has clear owners, timelines, deadlines, priorities, documentation, and next steps.

* Maintain a large caseload of projects simultaneously without losing track of details.

* Monitor deadlines and proactively follow up with team members when tasks are approaching due dates or becoming overdue.

* Identify blockers, missing information, dependencies, approval needs, and potential delays before they become larger problems.

* Ensure completed work moves through the appropriate review, approval, revision, and delivery process.

* Maintain visibility across active, upcoming, delayed, completed, and paused projects.

* Help prioritize projects based on deadlines, business importance, client needs, team capacity, and CEO direction.

* Ensure that decisions made in meetings,
s, messages, and other communications are converted into actionable tasks.



### ClickUp Management



ClickUp will be the primary project management system for this role.



The Project Management & Operations Lead will be expected to:



* Maintain and organize ClickUp across companies, brands, departments, lists, folders, projects, and client accounts.

* Create and assign tasks based on meetings,
s, conversations, and project requests.

* Maintain accurate task descriptions, due dates, owners, priorities, dependencies, subtasks, comments, and attachments.

* Ensure ClickUp reflects the actual current status of company projects.

* Follow up with team members to ensure tasks are updated consistently.

* Build and improve workflows, dashboards, templates, automations, statuses, and recurring processes within ClickUp.

* Identify opportunities to simplify or improve how ClickUp is being used.

* Convert
s and client communications into actionable ClickUp tasks and updates.

* Connect related tasks so teams can understand project dependencies and next steps.

* Maintain project notes, approvals, revision requests, and communication history.

* Create recurring tasks for ongoing responsibilities, reporting, meetings, and deliverables.

* Use ClickUp dashboards and reporting features to provide leadership visibility into project health, overdue work, workloads, and deadlines.



Strong ClickUp experience is highly preferred.



### Team Management & Coordination



* Coordinate and manage workflows across teams of up to 20 people.

* Conduct regular meetings and check-ins with team members.

* Follow up on active assignments, deadlines, priorities, blockers, and capacity.

* Ensure team members understand what they are responsible for and when work is due.

* Escalate issues when timelines, workload, quality, or communication problems require leadership involvement.

* Help identify when team members are overloaded or when workloads need to be redistributed.

* Maintain consistent communication across departments and project teams.

* Encourage accountability without requiring the CEO to personally follow up on every task.

* Ensure important updates are documented in ClickUp rather than remaining only in meetings or chat conversations.

* Help coordinate collaboration when projects require multiple departments or team members.



### CEO Project Management & Accountability



A major responsibility of this role will be ensuring the CEO has clear visibility into all major projects and responsibilities.



The Project Management & Operations Lead will:



* Maintain a standing individual meeting with the CEO to review active projects, deadlines, priorities, blockers, approvals, and upcoming work.

* Keep the CEO informed of anything that is working, not working, missing, delayed, overdue, or waiting for executive input.

* Identify decisions and approvals that require the CEO's attention.

* Follow up with the CEO on outstanding approvals, deliverables, meetings, decisions, or information needed by the team.

* Help organize and prioritize the CEO's project-related responsibilities.

* Set up meetings on the CEO's calendar when necessary.

* Ensure upcoming deadlines and meetings are properly prepared for.

* Provide concise summaries so the CEO can quickly understand project health without having to review every individual task.

* Hold the CEO accountable for project-related responsibilities and deadlines when the team is waiting for executive action.

* Maintain clear documentation of CEO decisions and communicate those decisions to the appropriate team members.



The goal is for the CEO to always have a clear understanding of what is moving forward, what needs attention, and where intervention is required.



### Meeting Management & Follow-Up



* Attend daily start-of-day meetings to review current priorities, assignments, deadlines, and blockers.

* Maintain at least one recurring individual project management meeting with the CEO.

* Attend additional project or team meetings when needed.

* Review recorded meetings when the Project Management & Operations Lead was not present.

* Listen to meeting recordings and identify decisions, assignments, deadlines, follow-ups, and action items.

* Convert meeting action items into ClickUp tasks.

* Ensure the correct team members receive meeting recordings, AI-generated meeting notes, summaries, or supporting documentation when necessary.

* Review AI-generated meeting notes for accuracy before relying on them for project documentation.

* Update existing projects and tasks based on new information discussed during meetings.

* Ensure decisions from meetings do not get lost once the meeting ends.

* Follow up with responsible team members regarding action items.



### Client Communication & Project Support



Although this role will not be fully client-facing, the Project Management & Operations Lead will support external communication as needed.



Responsibilities may include:



* Communicating project updates to clients.

* Sending project check-ins.

* Following up on outstanding client approvals, materials, feedback, or information.

* Helping coordinate meetings between clients and the CEO or appropriate team members.

* Drafting or organizing project-related
s.

* Converting client
s into ClickUp tasks, comments, updates, or revision requests.

* Tracking client feedback and ensuring revisions are assigned appropriately.

* Maintaining clear documentation of client requests.

* Preparing project status summaries before client meetings.

* Ensuring client requests are acknowledged and assigned.

* Helping ensure client deliverables move through internal review before being sent.

* Supporting follow-up communication after meetings.



This person should be comfortable communicating professionally with clients through
 or written communication when required.



### Workflow & Process Optimization



This role will be expected to continuously improve how work is managed throughout the company.



Responsibilities include:



* Review existing workflows and identify inefficiencies.

* Recommend improvements to project management systems and processes.

* Create standardized workflows for recurring project types.

* Develop templates, checklists, recurring tasks, and documentation.

* Reduce unnecessary manual steps where possible.

* Help automate repetitive project management processes.

* Identify communication gaps between teams.

* Improve handoffs between departments.

* Ensure processes scale as the company and team grow.

* Help create clearer accountability around ownership, approvals, and deadlines.

* Document new processes so team members understand how work should move through the company.

* Regularly review whether existing systems are still working effectively.



### Reporting & Leadership Visibility



* Provide regular project status updates to the CEO.

* Maintain dashboards that show project health and workload.

* Track overdue tasks and upcoming deadlines.

* Identify projects that are at risk of falling behind.

* Provide summaries of completed work, current work, upcoming priorities, and blockers.

* Help leadership understand where team capacity may be limited.

* Track outstanding client approvals and internal approvals.

* Maintain accurate records so leadership can understand the status of projects without having to search through individual messages or
s.

* Prepare reports or summaries when requested.



## Required Skills & Experience



* Professional experience in project management, operations, or a related leadership role.

* Strong experience using ClickUp as a project management platform.

* Experience managing or coordinating teams of up to 20 people.

* Experience managing multiple projects, departments, clients, or brands simultaneously.

* Strong understanding of project management principles, timelines, dependencies, ownership, and accountability.

* Ability to maintain a large project caseload without losing track of details.

* Excellent organization and prioritization skills.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Comfortable leading meetings and conducting regular team check-ins.

* Comfortable working directly with a CEO or executive.

* Ability to follow up consistently and respectfully with team members and leadership.

* Experience converting meetings,

* Experience creating standard operating procedures and process documentation.

* Experience building project management dashboards for executives.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal candidate is someone who naturally takes ownership.



They should not need to be repeatedly reminded to follow up on deadlines, update projects, ask for missing information, or notify leadership when something is going wrong.



They should be comfortable being the person who knows where projects stand and what needs to happen next.



This person should enjoy organization, systems, communication, planning, and problem solving. They should be able to manage a large number of moving pieces while still understanding which items require immediate attention.



They should also be comfortable communicating with team members and leadership consistently. If a task is overdue, they should follow up. If a project is blocked, they should determine why. If the CEO needs to approve something, they should make sure it gets in front of the CEO. If a meeting creates five new assignments, those assignments should be documented and assigned before they are forgotten.



The Project Management & Operations Lead should ultimately make it easier for the entire company to understand what needs to happen, who is responsible, and when work should be completed.



## Daily Expectations



* Attend the daily start-of-day team meeting.

* Review ClickUp for active projects, deadlines, overdue work, and new requests.

* Update and organize projects based on current information.

* Follow up with team members regarding assignments and deadlines.

* Review
s and communications that need to become tasks or project updates.

* Create new tasks and assignments from meetings and client communications.

* Monitor projects for blockers, missing approvals, and delays.

* Communicate important updates to the CEO.

* Coordinate meetings when needed.

* Maintain accurate documentation in ClickUp.

* Ensure team members have access to necessary meeting notes, recordings, files, and project information.

* Review upcoming deadlines and prepare teams accordingly.



## Weekly Expectations



* Conduct a standing individual project management meeting with the CEO.

* Review every major active project and provide updates on status, deadlines, blockers, approvals, missing information, and next steps.

* Review overdue tasks and determine how they will be resolved.

* Review team workloads and capacity.

* Identify projects at risk of missing deadlines.

* Ensure upcoming client deliverables are properly scheduled.

* Review whether processes or workflows need improvement.

* Provide leadership with a clear understanding of what requires attention during the upcoming week.



## Success in This Role Looks Like



* Leadership always understands the status of major projects.

* Team members understand their priorities and deadlines.

* Projects do not disappear or become forgotten.

* Client requests are documented and assigned.

* Meetings consistently result in clear action items.

* ClickUp accurately reflects what is actually happening within the company.

* Overdue work is identified quickly and followed up on.

* The CEO understands what requires approval or action without having to search for information.

* Team members receive the information they need to complete their work.

* Project workflows continuously become more organized and efficient.

* Client and internal communication is documented properly.

* Large numbers of active projects can move simultaneously without creating unnecessary confusion.

* Deadlines, ownership, accountability, and next steps remain visible across the organization.



## Work Style



This role is best for someone who is:



* Extremely organized.

* Proactive.

* Accountable.

* Comfortable following up with others.

* Strong at managing people and personalities.

* Able to communicate professionally with executives.

* Comfortable managing many projects simultaneously.

* Detail-oriented.

* Process-driven.

* Comfortable making decisions.

* Able to identify problems before they become emergencies.

* Comfortable working with remote teams.

* Strong with written documentation.

* Reliable with deadlines.

* Comfortable operating with a high level of responsibility.

* Interested in improving systems rather than simply maintaining them.



## Summary



The **Project Management & Operations Lead** at Atmospheric Thinking will serve as the central owner of projects across multiple companies, brands, internal initiatives, and client accounts.



This person will manage ClickUp, coordinate team members, track deadlines, organize client communications, convert meetings and
s into actionable work, maintain project documentation, support the CEO, improve workflows, and ensure projects continue moving from assignment through completion.



The ultimate purpose of this role is to create accountability, organization, visibility, and consistency across the company so leadership and team members always understand what needs to happen next.

title: Client Services Coordinator
description:
We are a performance marketing agency based outside Atlanta, Georgia. We run paid search, SEO, paid social, programmatic, and web services for small and mid-sized businesses across the U.S. Our clients trust us to move their numbers, and staying close to their accounts is how we keep that trust.



We are hiring a Client Services Coordinator to help us stay close to every client.



What This Role Is



This is an entry-level, client-facing support role. You will start from the ground up. We will train you on our clients, our process, and our tools. As you grow, you will take on more ownership of the accounts you support.



You will not be running ad campaigns yourself. Your job is to keep our clients organized, informed, and well cared for. You are the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks and every client feels taken care of.



This is a role for someone who wants to learn and grow with an agency. What matters most to us is not what you already know, but your written and spoken English, your attention to detail, and your willingness to be taught.



What You Will Be Doing



Learn every account. Get to know the status, goals, deliverables, and open items for each client. Over time, you become the person who can speak to any account at a moment's notice.



Join client calls. Attend calls alongside the team, take clear and thorough notes in real time, and track every decision and action item.



Write call summaries and next steps. After each call, send a clean, well-written recap to the client covering what was discussed, what was d
, and what happens next, with clear owners and dates.



Send finalized reports. Deliver monthly performance reports to clients once they have been reviewed and finalized internally, with a short, clear note framing the results.



Assemble client-facing materials. Put together decks, recaps, onboarding documents, and other materials that keep clients informed and confident.



Keep communication tight. Respond to client questions promptly, chase down answers internally, and make sure follow-ups actually get followed up on.



Be the connective tissue. Serve as the organized link between our specialists (search, social, SEO, web) and the client, so everyone stays aligned.



What We Are Looking For



Exceptional written English. Your
s and summaries read as polished, professional, and native-level. Grammar, tone, and clarity are second nature.



Exceptional spoken English. You are clear, confident, and easy to understand on live client calls with U.S. business owners.



Meticulous attention to detail. You catch the small things, keep accurate notes, and never let an action item slip.



Strong organization. You can hold the details of many clients in order at once and always know the current state of each.



Eager to learn. You are coachable, take feedback well, and want to build a career in client services. We will train you. You bring the willingness.



Proactive and reliable. You follow through without being chased and take real ownership of what you are given.



Nice to Have (Not Required)



Experience in digital marketing, an agency, or client services / account management.



Familiarity with paid search, SEO, paid social, or web projects. Enough to follow the conversation, not to execute it.



Comfort with tools like Google Workspace, Slack, project management software, and reporting dashboards.



Details



Schedule: Full-time, Monday through Friday, U.S. Eastern business hours. This means evening and overnight hours in the Philippines.

Type: Independent contractor, entry-level, with full training provided.

Location: Remote, based in the Philippines.

Reports to: Managing Director.

Requirements: Dependable internet connection and a quiet space for calls.



How to Apply



Answer these 3 things. Applications that do not include all 3 will not be reviewed.



A short introduction telling us why this role fits you. This is your first writing sample. We read it closely.

Your resume. Write a sample client
: You just finished a call with a client who runs a dental practice. On the call, you discussed their Google Ads performance from last month (leads were up 15% but cost per lead increased), agreed to test new ad copy next month, and the client asked about adding SEO services. title: Operations & Logistics Coordinator – Medical Repatriation

        - Following established operational procedures and escalating questions or potential problems when appropriate

        - Answering operational phone calls and messages during the assigned shift



*WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR*



The successful candidate should have:



        - Excellent written and spoken English

        - Strong attention to detail and accuracy

        - Excellent organizational and multitasking skills

        - Good judgment and problem-solving ability

        - Confidence working independently while knowing when to ask questions or escalate an issue

        - Strong communication skills and willingness to actively engage with a remote international team

        - Good working knowledge of Google Sheets and Google Workspace

        - Ability to learn new systems and procedures quickly

        - Reliable high-speed internet and a suitable backup solution in case of connectivity problems

        - Full availability during the scheduled working hours

        - Experience in travel coordination, airline reservations, logistics, healthcare administration, medical assistance, assistance companies, or 24/7 operations is a strong advantage but is not required if you demonstrate strong operational and problem-solving skills.



*COMPENSATION*



USD $10 per hour, 40 hours per week.

*AVAILABILITY*
