title: Recruitment Resourcer
description:
Garry Howling Recruitment is a specialist recruitment business operating across the UK accountancy profession. We have ambitious plans to build a high-growth, market-leading recruitment company, and we are looking for an exceptional Recruitment Resourcer to play a central role in that growth.



This is not an administrative resourcing position, and it is not a role for someone who waits to be given a daily list of tasks. We need an exceptionally proactive, intelligent and commercially aware individual who naturally takes ownership, spots opportunities and makes things happen.



The successful person must take complete responsibility for every task and agreed action, progressing it promptly and following it through to its proper conclusion without needing to be chased. Sending an initial message, beginning a piece of research or simply reporting an opportunity will not, by itself, be regarded as completing the task. We need somebody who remains responsible until the intended outcome has been achieved, properly recorded and clearly communicated.



You will work closely with the business owner, supporting him by generating high-quality candidate conversations, identifying recruitment opportunities and progressing those opportunities as far as possible. You will undertake sourcing, research, initial engagement, qualification and follow-up, allowing the business owner to become the senior touchpoint with candidates and clients at the most commercially important stages.



The right person will be able to take a small piece of market information and turn it into a structured commercial plan. For example, if you discover that an accountancy firm is recruiting, you will not simply report that information. You will research the firm, identify the relevant decision-makers, understand its likely recruitment requirements, recommend an appropriate engagement strategy and take proactive steps to create a conversation, meeting or commercial opportunity.



You must be resourceful, progressive and comfortable working with significant independence. Success will be measured through conversations, meetings, candidates, opportunities and commercial outcomes—not simply by the number of tasks started or messages sent.



Key responsibilities



Candidate sourcing and engagement



• Proactively identify high-quality accountancy professionals who may be suitable for current or future opportunities.

• Build detailed talent pools across specific locations, disciplines and levels of seniority.

• Create persuasive, highly personalised approaches that generate genuine candidate interest.

• Engage professionally with potential candidates through appropriate online platforms,
, telephone and other suitable channels.

• Follow up intelligently and persistently without requiring reminders or continual direction.

• Conduct initial candidate qualification conversations to establish experience, qualifications, location, salary, notice period, career aspirations and reasons for considering a move.

• Obtain current CVs and relevant background information before booking candidates to speak with the business owner.

• Schedule qualified candidate meetings directly into the business owner’s diary.

• Maintain relationships with candidates who may not be ready to move immediately.

• Ask candidates for referrals and use market intelligence to identify further opportunities.

• Ensure candidate records, communications and activity notes are accurately maintained within the CRM.

• Continue progressing candidate relationships until an appropriate outcome or agreed follow-up position has been reached.



Market intelligence and opportunity creation



• Monitor the UK accountancy recruitment market and identify firms that are recruiting, growing, acquiring other businesses or likely to require recruitment support.

• Turn small pieces of information into practical, commercially focused action plans.

• Research prospective clients, including their structure, locations, vacancies, decision-makers and potential recruitment challenges.

• Develop tailored engagement approaches for individual firms rather than relying on generic messages.

• Initiate contact and work towards generating introductory meetings for the business owner.

• Recognise commercial opportunities arising from candidate conversations and market research.

• Progress every credible lead promptly rather than merely recording or reporting it.

• Follow commercial opportunities through until the intended action has been completed or a clear outcome has been achieved.

• Recommend new searches, campaigns, talent pools and market opportunities based on the information you uncover.

• Work collaboratively with the Marketing Manager to convert campaigns, responses and market visibility into candidate and client conversations.

• Identify obstacles affecting results, recommend solutions and adjust the approach when necessary.



Supporting the business owner



• Become a highly dependable extension of the business owner.

• Anticipate what needs to happen next and take appropriate action without waiting to be instructed.

• Protect the business owner’s time by completing research, initial engagement, qualification and follow-up before involving him.

• Provide concise, useful information that enables fast commercial decisions.

• Prepare the business owner thoroughly for candidate and client meetings.

• Follow up agreed actions immediately after meetings and ensure opportunities continue moving forward.

• Bring forward ideas, solutions and recommended actions—not simply questions or problems.

• Take responsibility for filling the business owner’s diary with worthwhile candidate and prospective-client conversations.

• Take complete ownership of assigned tasks and agreed actions, ensuring they are progressed promptly and followed through to full completion without requiring reminders.

• Remain responsible for each piece of work from the initial instruction through to the intended outcome.

• Proactively resolve obstacles and communicate promptly if additional information, authority or support is genuinely required.

• Never regard a task as complete simply because the first action has been taken; ensure the required outcome has been achieved, accurately recorded and clearly communicated.

• Maintain a reliable system for monitoring every commitment, deadline and follow-up so that nothing is overlooked or allowed to lose 
ntum.



The person we are looking for



The successful applicant must be:



• Extremely proactive: You naturally take action, follow through and continually look for the next opportunity.

• Accountable and completion-focused: You take personal ownership of every task and agreed action, follow it through to its proper conclusion and can be trusted to deliver without being chased.

• Commercially minded: You understand that the purpose of your work is to generate conversations, relationships, vacancies and placements.

• Resourceful: You can take limited information, research it properly and turn it into something commercially valuable.

• Highly independent: You can manage your workload and generate productive activity without constant supervision.

• Persistent: You follow up appropriately and do not allow worthwhile opportunities to disappear through lack of action.

• Intelligent and analytical: You can interpret information, identify connections and d
 on the most effective next step.

• An exceptional communicator: Your spoken and written English must be of an outstanding professional standard.

• Confident: You must be comfortable communicating with experienced UK professionals and senior business decision-makers.

• Organised: You can manage multiple searches, follow-ups, candidate relationships and commercial leads without losing 
ntum.

• Dependable: If you commit to completing something, the business owner can trust that it will be completed properly, on time and to the required standard.

• Adaptable: You respond positively to changing priorities and a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment.

• Outcome-focused: You measure your success through tangible results rather than general activity.



Essential requirements



• Educated to degree level.

• Exceptional written and spoken English.

• Previous experience in recruitment sourcing, executive search, candidate generation, lead generation, business development or another relevant commercially focused role.

• Demonstrable experience of working independently and creating opportunities without waiting for detailed instructions.

• Evidence of taking ownership of work and following tasks through to full completion.

• Strong online research and market-mapping ability.

• Confidence in initiating professional conversations by telephone,
 and other communication channels.

• Ability to write persuasive and highly personalised outreach.

• Experience using a CRM or similar database system.

• Excellent attention to detail and record-keeping.

• A reliable, high-speed internet connection and professional home-working environment.

• Availability to work approximately 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. UK time, Monday to Friday. Local working hours will change when the UK moves between British Summer Time and Greenwich Mean Time.



Performance measures



Success in this role will be assessed through measurable commercial outcomes, including:



• Qualified candidate conversations generated.

• Candidate meetings booked and attended.

• High-quality candidates introduced against live and prospective vacancies.

• Updated CVs and candidate information obtained.

• Candidate relationships developed and reactivated.

• Recruitment leads and prospective clients identified.

• Introductory client meetings created.

• Quality and personalisation of outreach.

• Speed and consistency of follow-up.

• Completion of tasks and agreed actions without reminders.

• Accuracy and completeness of CRM records.

• Evidence of independent ideas, initiative and commercial ownership.

• Ability to turn limited information into valuable candidate or client opportunities.

• Contribution to the continued growth of the business.



What this role is not



This is not a general virtual assistant, data-entry or purely administrative position. It is not suitable for somebody who needs every task to be explained, waits for instructions or regards sending a message or beginning a task as the finished outcome.

We are looking for someone who asks:

“What commercial opportunity can I create from this information, what should happen next, and what can I do now to move it forward?”

The successful person will be ambitious, energetic and determined to become a key contributor to the development of a substantial UK recruitment business. This is an opportunity to work closely with an experienced recruitment business owner, take genuine responsibility and build a role with considerable long-term scope.



Engagement details



This is a full-time, self-employed independent contractor opportunity. The successful applicant will not be employed directly by Garry Howling Recruitment and will be responsible for managing and paying their own tax, statutory contributions, insurance and any other obligations arising in their country of residence.



The contractor will be expected to provide their own suitable computer equipment, reliable high-speed internet connection and professional home-working environment.



The role requires availability to work approximately 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. UK time, Monday to Friday. Working hours in the contractor’s location will therefore change when the UK moves between British Summer Time and Greenwich Mean Time.

Although this is an independent contractor position, we are looking for someone who wants to work closely with the business owner and wider team and make a significant, long-term contribution to the growth of Garry Howling Recruitment.



Application process



The application process is expected to include:



1. CV/resume submission and initial application review.

2. Shortlisting of selected applicants.

3. Short video introduction of approximately two to four minutes, requested from shortlisted applicants only.

4. Initial interview.

5. Practical assessment task.

6. Final interview.

7. Independent contractor offer.



Applicants who progress through the process may be asked to demonstrate their:



• Research and market-mapping ability.

• Written and spoken communication.

• Commercial judgement and initiative.

• Candidate engagement skills.

• Ability to turn limited information into a practical commercial plan.

• Approach to following tasks and opportunities through to completion.

• Ability to create activity and commercial opportunities without continual direction.

• Confidence when conducting a mock candidate conversation.



All information and work submitted during the application process must be the applicant’s own and must accurately represent their experience and capabilities.

title: Senior SEO Manager: $8 to $10 per hour
description:
About Us: We are a U.S.-based web design, digital marketing, and SEO agency with over 16+ years of experience helping businesses grow through organic search and lead generation.



We are seeking a highly experienced Senior SEO Manager with a proven track record of ranking home service businesses in competitive U.S. local markets.



=> Important Requirement Before Applying:



To be considered for an interview, you must provide SEO reports or case studies from at least three successful local or national 



SEO campaigns completed within the last 12 months.



Applications without verifiable recent SEO results will not be considered.



About the Role:



This is not a strategy-only position.



We are looking for a hands-on SEO leader who can actively manage, execute, optimize, and improve SEO campaigns across multiple client accounts while overseeing SEO team members.



You must be comfortable working directly inside websites, identifying technical and content issues, implementing solutions, and driving measurable improvements in rankings, traffic, and lead generation.



If you have successfully ranked businesses in industries such as HVAC, roofing, plumbing, electrical, landscaping, pest control, or similar service categories, and understand how Google Business Profiles, local landing pages, and service-area SEO generate leads, this role is for you.



Key Responsibilities

1. SEO Strategy, Execution & Team Management

Manage SEO campaigns across multiple client accounts

Oversee and mentor SEO specialists and content teams

Prioritize tasks based on impact and business goals

Ensure consistent execution of SEO processes and SOPs

Drive measurable improvements in rankings (AI Overview, ChatGPT, Perplexity), organic traffic, and lead generation



2. On-Page SEO & Content Optimization

Optimize service pages, city/location pages, and blog content for local search intent and conversions

Review and improve SEO content including service pages, FAQs, and blog articles

Implement proper heading structures (H1-H4), internal linking strategies, schema markup, and conversion-focused calls-to-action

Align content with search intent and user needs—not just keyword placement

Identify content gaps and expansion opportunities



3. Technical SEO



Perform comprehensive technical SEO audits and implement recommendations, including:

Core Web Vitals optimization

Crawlability and indexation improvements

Site architecture and internal linking enhancements

Redirect management, canonicalization, and noindex implementation

Structured data and schema markup implementation

WordPress SEO optimization across various themes and page builders



You should be comfortable working directly with developers and clearly communicating technical requirements, priorities, and expected outcomes.



4. Local SEO (High Priority)

Fully optimize Google Business Profiles, including categories, services, products, media, posts, and FAQs

Build and optimize city, neighborhood, and service-area landing pages

Maintain citation consistency and NAP accuracy across directories

Develop strategies to improve local visibility and map pack rankings

Demonstrate a strong understanding of proximity, relevance, prominence, and local ranking signals



5. SOP Execution & Continuous Improvement

Follow established SEO SOPs with consistency and accountability

Identify process gaps and opportunities for improvement

Contribute to developing scalable SEO systems and documentation

Maintain organized task management and reporting processes



6. Analytics, Reporting & Performance Tracking

Monitor rankings, traffic, conversions, and lead generation metrics

Conduct SEO audits and competitive analysis

Translate SEO data into actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams

Deliver clear performance reporting and strategic insights



Experience with Search Atlas is a strong advantage.



Required Qualifications

Must-Have

7+ years of hands-on SEO experience

Proven success ranking U.S.-based home service businesses

Demonstrated local SEO expertise with Google Business Profiles and local search campaigns

Strong technical SEO knowledge and implementation experience

Advanced on-page SEO and content optimization skills

Extensive experience with WordPress websites



Strong knowledge of:

Ahrefs

SEMrush

BrightLocal

Screaming Frog

Google Search Console

Google Analytics



Experience implementing schema markup for local and service businesses

Ability to provide recent SEO reports or case studies demonstrating measurable results

Process-driven mindset with strong documentation and communication skills

Preferred Qualifications

Agency experience managing multiple client accounts

Experience managing SEO teams

Familiarity with CRO (Conversion Rate Optimization)

Experience with Search Atlas

What Success Looks Like



Within the first 6–12 months, you will:

Improve rankings for high-value service and city keywords

Increase qualified leads from organic search and Google Business Profiles

Deliver scalable SEO implementations across multiple websites

Improve execution efficiency through stronger SOPs and processes

Help clients achieve measurable business growth through SEO



How to Apply



Please submit:

Your resume

A brief summary of your home services SEO experience

SEO reports or case studies from at least three successful campaigns completed within the last 12 months

Examples of rankings, traffic growth, lead generation improvements, or other measurable SEO outcomes



Applications without recent proof of results will not be considered.

 & CRM

What We're Looking For

What Success Looks Like

title: eCommerce Product Operations Specialist
description:
The company

A profitable, growing US-based specialty Tea Subscription ecommerce brand (~15% YoY, 130K+ lifetime orders) selling through Shopify, TikTok Shop, and a subscription program, with international warehouses in the US, Canada, UK, and EU. The store operations side of the business is run by one teammate who is moving to a technical lead role, you'll be his right hand.



The role

You take the store operational work off the Technical Lead's plate so he can build. This is execution, monitoring, and data maintenance work, done reliably and precisely. You are not making purchasing decisions or writing code. You ARE the person who makes sure listings are right, inventory data is current, orders are tracked, and nothing falls through the cracks.

This role is also a growth path: the brand runs custom-built software and an AI agent for inventory intelligence. Start with the basics done flawlessly, and you'll be trained into the more complex systems.



What you'll do



Product listings and administration (Shopify + TikTok Shop)

-Create draft product listings from provided info: photos, videos, descriptions, SKUs, tags, collections, pricing

-Keep Shopify and TikTok Shop listings matched and in sync

-Audit listings for missing images, broken info, wrong tags; prep new listings for final review

-Handle backend product work: tagging, pricing updates, bundle linking (the brand has many SKUs and complex bundles)



Purchasing data maintenance

-Maintain the buying table used for purchasing coordination with the overseas team

-Log ordered products, tag in-transit inventory in the forecasting tool (Prediko), update incoming quantities

-Flag missing or inconsistent data. Buying decisions stay with the Technical Lead and sourcing team; your job is making sure the data they d
 from is right

-Inventory, orders, and fulfillment monitoring

-Routine checks on warehouse/fulfillment status and shipment tracking across Shopify, OMS, and spreadsheets

-Flag unresolved orders instead of letting them sit



Website support and QA

-Handle simple Shopify/website requests from the Customer Service team: text, images, FAQs, links, product settings

-Run checklist-based testing after site changes; test customer-facing scenarios, document issues with screenshots and repro steps, escalate anything technical



Task hygiene

-Keep Asana organized: statuses updated, stale tasks flagged, follow-ups chased



What you need

Hands-on Shopify admin experience (listings, products, collections, basic settings). TikTok Shop experience is a strong plus

Precise, reliable, detail-obsessed. This role is 80% "did it get done correctly, every time"

Comfortable in spreadsheets and matching data across systems

Smart enough to learn custom internal software. You don't need to code; you need to not be scared of new tools

Genuinely curious about AI tools: open, playful, and safe with them. You'll eventually work alongside an AI inventory agent

Strong written English; you'll coordinate with the Customer Service team and document issues clearly

Available during US Eastern business hours (any home timezone)



Nice to have

You drink tea, or want to. This brand sells specialty Chinese tea: loose leaf, pu-erh, oolong, matcha, teaware. Knowing the difference between a green tea and a red tea means you'll catch listing errors a generic VA never would, like a product tagged in the wrong category or a description that doesn't match the leaf. You don't need to be an expert; the team will happily deepen your education

Interest in Chinese culture or language

TikTok Shop seller-side experience

Experience supporting a founder-creator brand where product accuracy and authenticity are the standard

Prior QA or testing experience with documented repro steps

title: Senior Video Editor & Creative Strategist — Ecommerce, Meta Ads & VSLs
description:
We’re looking for an experienced Video Editor and Creative Strategist to take ownership of performance creatives for our ecommerce brands.



We currently generate five-figure daily revenue and are scaling toward six figures per day. We need someone who can deliver at that pace, think independently, and connect creative decisions to business results.



You must have hands-on experience creating video ads for Scandinavian ecommerce brands and other European markets. Please include relevant examples in your application.



THE ROLE



You will own the creative process from research and concept development through scripting, editing, performance analysis, and iteration.



We will provide winning ads, customer insights, and performance data so you understand what has worked. Your job is to turn those insights into fresh concepts, stronger angles, and original executions.



Simply copying existing ads, changing captions, or swapping clips is not enough. You should understand why an ad works and use that understanding to create something new.



We expect you to identify what is needed, make informed decisions, and deliver without requiring detailed instructions for every script, scene, or edit.



WHAT YOU WILL DO



• Develop original ad concepts, hooks, angles, and scripts based on customer motivations, objections, product positioning, and performance insights.



• Create short-form direct-response ads, UGC-style creatives, product demonstrations, and longer video sales letters.



• Plan and produce B-roll, including original AI-generated footage where appropriate, and source suitable licensed assets when needed.



• Build complete ads with strong pacing, clear storytelling, effective voiceovers, readable captions, sound design, and relevant visuals.



• Adapt creatives for Scandinavian and other European audiences, paying attention to language, cultural context, credibility, and buying behavior.



• Analyze creative performance using metrics such as hook rate, retention, CTR, conversion rate, CPA, and ROAS. Understand these metrics in the context of spend, audience, offer, and landing-page performance.



• Identify why an ad is succeeding or underperforming, then propose specific changes and new tests.



• Maintain an organized creative testing process with clear hypotheses, consistent file naming, and documented learnings.



WHAT WE REQUIRE



• Proven experience editing direct-response video ads for Scandinavian brands and other EU ecommerce markets.



• A portfolio demonstrating both strong editing and strategic thinking.



• Experience writing original scripts and building VSLs with a clear hook, problem, product explanation, proof, objection handling, and call to action.



• The ability to turn customer research and performance data into creative decisions.



• Strong judgment when selecting or creating B-roll. Visuals should support the message and product accurately.



• Reliable communication, fast execution, attention to detail, and the ability to manage several creative tests at once.



• Ownership of the work: proactively suggest ideas, flag missing information, solve problems, and follow through.



• Your own editing software, creative tools, and any subscriptions needed to produce the work.



Success in this role means consistently producing fresh, well-reasoned creatives, learning from their performance, and improving the next round of ads.



IMPORTANT — UNPAID TRIAL AD



If your portfolio is shortlisted, you will be asked to create one unpaid trial ad so we can assess your actual editing, scripting, and creative strategy skills.



You must use your own software, tools, and subscriptions to complete the test.



Please apply only if you accept these conditions and can independently deliver work that matches the quality of your portfolio. This helps both sides avoid wasting time.



IMPORTANT — WRITE YOUR OWN APPLICATION



AI-generated applications will be ignored and will not receive a response.



Write your application in your own words. We want specific examples of your experience, your contribution to the work, and how you think about creative performance. Generic cover letters and copy-paste answers will not be considered.



HOW TO APPLY



Please include:



Three to five relevant ads you personally worked on, including at least one VSL or longer direct-response video.



The Scandinavian and European brands or markets you have worked with. If client names are confidential, describe the market, product category, and your responsibilities.



Your exact contribution to each example: strategy, research, scripting, B-roll, editing, or the complete process.



One example of how you used performance data to improve a creative. Explain the problem, what you changed, and the result. Redacted screenshots are welcome where you have permission to share them.



The tools you use for editing, research, B-roll production, and AI-assisted creative work.



Your weekly availability, earliest start date, and expected hourly or monthly rate.



Confirmation that you understand and accept the unpaid trial requirement and will use your own tools.



We are hiring as soon as possible and are looking for a reliable, long-term collaborator. Applications with relevant work examples and clear evidence of independent thinking will receive priority.

10. Look for patterns and additional opportunities instead of simply completing a checklist.

📊 QUALITY MATTERS MORE THAN VOLUME



We are NOT looking for someone who says:

We want someone who can say:



“I found 500 records, verified 430, removed duplicates, identified the actual owners, documented the source, and prioritized the 75 strongest opportunities.”

title: Full Cycle Bookkeeper - Experienced 5 yr +
description:
Read this entire posting before applying. If you skip to the apply button, you will be rejected automatically.

I am done wasting time and money on VAs who overpromise and underdeliver. This posting is intentionally blunt so only qualified, serious candidates apply. If you do not meet ALL of the requirements below, do not apply — you will not be considered, and applications that ignore this will be deleted without a response.

Non-Negotiable Requirements — ALL of these are deal-breakers if not met:



1 -Speak and write English clearly. If you have a thick accent or are not fluent in written and spoken English, do not apply. This is an immediate disqualifier.

2 - Be an actual, hands-on expert in bookkeeping, payroll, and HR administration. I use QuickBooks Online, Cin7 Core for inventory/COGS, QBO for AP, and QBO for payroll. If you claim experience with these tools and then have to Google how to do basic tasks once hired, this is an immediate disqualifier. You will be tested before hire — see below.

3 - Explain things simply. I am not an accountant. If I ask you a question and you can't break it down in plain language I understand right away, do not apply. I need someone who translates the technical into the simple, not someone who talks over my head.

4 - Follow instructions exactly. I have had VAs guess at what I wanted, get "creative," do work I never asked for, and then expect to be paid for it. This happens ONCE and we're done. I am open to your suggestions on better ways to do things — but only with my approval before you act. Suggest, don't assume.

5 - Do not pad your hours. I know roughly how long tasks take, and I am generous about it. If I see 15-minute tasks billed as multi-hour tasks, my generosity disappears immediately and so does the job.

6 - Show up on time, every time. I understand life happens — tell me in advance and I will be understanding. Chronic lateness or last-minute excuses (storms, internet outages, etc., without advance notice) will end this immediately. One strike.

7 - We pay via Payoneer ONLY. No exceptions. If you don't have a Payoneer account or can't set one up, do not apply. This is nonnegotiable — no PayPal, no Wise, no bank transfer, no other method.

8 - We track time using Timeproof. Mandatory, no exceptions. If you are not willing to use Timeproof for every hour billed, do not apply. This is not up for discussion.

9 - Meetings are professional — no children visible or audible on camera. These are leadership meetings. My team does not bring kids into the office, and I expect the same from you. Have children asleep, at school, or with another caregiver during our scheduled meeting times. If a child is on camera or heard in the background, the meeting will end.

10 - If I call you during paid hours, you answer. Period. No exceptions, no "I saw it but was busy." If you're on the clock, you're reachable.



What You'll Be Doing:



Full-cycle bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online — transaction coding, reconciliations, AP/AR

Inventory and COGS tracking and reconciliation in Cin7 Core

Vendor bill capture, approval routing, and payment processing through or QBO

Payroll support and coordination through Paylocity

HR administrative support — onboarding documentation, recordkeeping, basic compliance tasks

Monthly financial reporting to ownership



Application Instructions — Read Carefully:



To prove you read this far, start your application with the word LEDGER in the subject line. Applications without it will not be opened.

Confirm in your application that you have a Payoneer account, are willing to use Timeproof for every hour worked, can keep meetings child-free, and will answer calls during paid hours. If you don't confirm all four, your application will be skipped.

Include your specific hands-on experience with QuickBooks Online and/or Cin7 Core — not "familiar with," actual experience.

Include your available start date and your hourly rate expectation.

Be prepared to complete a short paid skills test before any offer is made.



This is a long-term, part-time position for the right person, with room to grow. If you meet every requirement above and can prove it, I want to hear from you. If you don't, please save us both the time.

Cut Above Landscaping is a growing landscaping company in the US. We're hiring an Executive Virtual Assistant to be the first voice our customers hear and the person who keeps our sales team's calendar full and running smoothly.



This is a phone-heavy role. If you don't enjoy talking to people on the phone, this is not the job for you. But it's also a detail-heavy role, and that's where most people we've hired before have fallen short. We've had assistants who were great on the phone but sloppy with data entry, and assistants who were meticulous with data but froze up on calls. We need someone who is strong at both.



What you'll do



Call new leads and book estimates (your top priority)



Call every new lead that comes in, quickly, and book them for an on-site estimate

Handle objections and questions confidently and professionally

Log every call, outcome, and appointment accurately



Cold call commercial properties (during downtime)



Call commercial properties and property managers to schedule meetings for our sales team

Keep organized notes on who you've contacted and when to follow up



Follow up on sent proposals



Contact prospects who have received a proposal from our sales team

Answer basic questions, push for a decision, and report status back to the sales team



Keep our systems accurate



Enter and update appointments and lead information in Google Calendar, GoHighLevel (GHL), and Aspire (our landscaping business software)

Every appointment must be entered correctly, completely, and in the right place. No exceptions.



Schedule with geography in mind



Our sales team drives to every estimate. You'll need to look at a map of our service area and understand which neighborhoods are close to each other and which are not.

Booking a salesman in one part of the city at 10:00 AM and then an hour's drive away at 11:00 AM is a scheduling failure, and it's happened before. You'll be expected to group appointments by area and route the sales team's day efficiently.

What we're looking for

Excellent spoken English with a clear, confident, friendly phone presence

Real sales or appointment-setting experience by phone (cold calling experience is a big plus)

Proven attention to detail with data entry and CRM work

Experience with GoHighLevel and/or Google Calendar; Aspire experience is a plus but we will train the right person

Comfortable reading Google Maps and thinking about drive times when scheduling

Reliable, fast internet, a quiet workspace, and a quality headset

Able to commit to the full 8 AM–4 PM US Central schedule, Monday through Friday, long-term



How to apply



A Loom video is required. Applications without one will not be reviewed.



Record a Loom video (3–5 minutes) covering:



Your experience with phone sales, appointment setting, and cold calling

Your experience with data entry and CRM tools (GHL, Google Calendar, Aspire, or similar)

Why you believe you can do BOTH the sales side and the detail side of this job well



Submit your Loom link along with your resume and your requested hourly rate within the $10–$14 range to 
 - replies on this platform will not be monitored 



We're looking for someone who wants a stable, long-term position with a company that values what they do. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you. If you have experience working with Aspire, you automatically move to the top of the list as long as you can prove it.

title: Founding People Operations & Talent Lead — Remote DTC/E-commerce
description:
We are a fast-growing remote DTC/e-commerce company hiring approximately 3–5 people per month across creative, growth, customer support, and operations roles.

We are hiring our first dedicated People leader. This is not a recruitment-only or HR administration role. Your mission is to build and personally run a practical People function that removes the Founder from routine hiring, onboarding, performance follow-up, employee issues, and people administration.

This is a hands-on builder role. You must be comfortable creating the systems and personally executing the work.

What You Will Own

- Build quarterly headcount plans and maintain hiring priorities.

- Recruit creative and growth talent, including Creative Strategists, Video Editors, Graphic Designers, Copywriters, Creator/UGC roles, Media Buyers, Customer Support, and Operations roles.

- Own recruitment from role intake, JD and sourcing through screening, interviews, trials, references, offers, and candidate follow-up.

- Build and run preboarding, onboarding, probation, contract-change, and offboarding processes.

- Maintain employee and contractor records, contracts, access registers, leave, attendance, payroll inputs, and important dates.

- Work with functional leads to establish role scorecards, KPIs, quality expectations, and probation standards.

- Run performance-review cadences and manage documentation, warnings, PIPs, difficult conversations, and follow-up actions.

- Serve as the first point of contact for routine employee questions, conflicts, leave, working hours, and manager communication.

- Build practical SOPs, trackers, dashboards, reminders, and reporting—not unnecessary bureaucracy.

- Send the Founder a concise weekly People update covering recruitment, probation, performance risks, employee issues, and decisions requiring Founder involvement.

Functional leads will continue to judge professional quality in creative, marketing, and other specialist areas. You will own the people process, evidence, communication, documentation, and follow-up action.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

- One reliable source of truth for all employees, contractors, contracts, and key dates.

- A visible recruitment dashboard and repeatable hiring process.

- Consistent onboarding and 30/60/90-day probation processes.

- Documented performance, warning, PIP, and offboarding procedures.

- Managers receive timely reminders and support.

- The Founder is no longer managing routine recruiting coordination, onboarding follow-ups, employee questions, or performance documentation.

What We Need

- Experience in a remote-first startup, DTC/e-commerce company, or performance marketing agency.

- Proven ownership of both end-to-end recruitment and People Operations.

- Evidence of systems personally built from scratch.

- Experience recruiting creative or performance-growth talent.

- Experience handling underperformance, employee conflict, PIPs, or termination.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Comfortable working independently and bringing proposed solutions—not simply escalating every issue.

- Willing to work hands-on without delegating sourcing, screening, and follow-up.

- Full-time availability without another conflicting full-time position.



How to Apply (Please follow otherwise will be ignored)

Please answer briefly but specifically:

1. Which remote startup or DTC/e-commerce company did you support, and approximately how large was the team?

2. List the main roles you personally filled during your most recent 12 active recruiting months, including approximate hiring numbers and time-to-fill, and which countries did you hire from. 

3. Describe one People process or SOP you personally built from scratch: what existed before, what you created, and the result.

4. Describe one underperformance, investigation, PIP, conflict, or termination case you personally handled.

5. Are you currently employed or supporting other clients? If hired, can you commit to one full-time role?

6. Your CV, expected monthly base, and your start date.

title: Outbound Caller & Lead Generation Specialist
description:
READ THIS FIRST: The shift is 8:00 PM to 3:00 AM Manila time, Monday to Friday. That is 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM in Florida. This is a permanent night schedule. If that will not work for you long term, please do not apply. We would rather you keep your time.



ABOUT US



We are NH Repairs, a commercial and municipal fleet maintenance shop in Pompano Beach, Florida. We service and repair the vehicles that local businesses and city governments run on: the work trucks of contractors, plumbers, electricians and landscapers, plus heavy-duty tractors and trailers. We are small, we are growing, and we have big plans.



We run lean. Every person here owns their work, and you will be working directly with the owner.



We are hiring one person to make our outbound calls and generate our leads. That is the whole job, and right now it is the most important open seat in the company.



This is a phone-first role. You will spend most of your shift on the phone: calling back the people who contacted us, calling the customers who were quoted work and never came back, and calling businesses in our target lists. Text and
 back you up, they do not replace the call.



WHAT YOU WILL ACTUALLY DO



Follow-up calling, about 45% of your time. This is the heart of the job. Right now leads slip through the cracks. You will stop that.



Call back every missed call the same day, and text as a backup when nobody picks up

Call every new inquiry from our ads within 5 minutes, while they are still d
 who to call

Work the deferred repair list: vehicles we already inspected, work we already quoted, jobs that were never scheduled

Follow up on open estimates until you get a yes or a no

Call back customers we have not seen in 6 months or more

Call after every completed repair to check in and ask for a review

Log every inbound call in our shared attribution tracker so we know which ads are producing real work and which ones are wasting money



Lead generation, about 45% of your time. Half of your leads are already sitting in our system. The other half are local fleets we have not called yet. You will work both.



Mine Fullbay for work that is already due: customers with preventive maintenance coming up, DOT inspections expiring, and units with open or deferred repairs. Call them and get the truck scheduled.

Go through our existing customer list unit by unit and find out what each fleet has coming up

Work our target lists of local businesses and fleets. We already have the lists. What we lack is the discipline to work them, and you will bring that.

Find the right person at each company, the owner, the fleet manager, or whoever signs off on repairs, and start a real conversation

Run supporting
 and SMS campaigns to the same lists

Keep calling until you get a yes or a no, and log every touch and every outcome



Marketing support, about 10%.



Help put together a newsletter twice a month, using AI tools heavily. We expect you to move fast with them.

Help with website content and messaging

Keep our message consistent across calls,
, text and social

Report on what is working and what is not



And whatever else the business needs. We are small and titles are loose here. If you see something broken and fix it, that gets noticed.



SYSTEMS YOU WILL LIVE IN



Fullbay, our shop management system. Every repair order, estimate, unit and customer history lives here, and it is where most of your leads will come from. You will learn it in your first two weeks. It is straightforward.

Our phone and SMS platform, currently being upgraded. You will help us make it work.

CRM,
 marketing tools, Google Sheets, and AI writing tools



You need to be genuinely comfortable with software. Not an engineer, but the kind of person who opens a new tool and figures it out without a manual, and who spots a better way to do something and says so.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



*Clear, confident spoken English. This is the most important requirement. You will be on the phone with American business owners, shop managers and municipal fleet staff every day, under our name. Neutral accent, easy to understand, comfortable holding a conversation that is not on a script.

*Strong written English. Your texts and
s go straight to customers. Clear and natural, not stiff and not robotic.

*Real outbound experience. You have called strangers and existing customers for a living and you are not nervous about it.

*Background we especially want: dealership service BDC, appointment setting, outbound sales or SDR work on a US account, service scheduling, customer retention or reactivation, US collections, or contact center work with an outbound component.

*Tech savvy. Comfortable in new software, spreadsheets, CRMs and AI tools.

*Relentless follow-up. Most of this job is the third and fourth call.

*Automotive, truck or fleet experience is a plus, not a requirement. We will teach you the vehicles.

*Reliable internet with a backup connection, backup power, a quiet workspace, and a good headset. On a night shift there is nobody to cover for you.



NOT A FIT IF



You cannot commit to a permanent night schedule

You are looking for general admin or virtual assistant work

You are uncomfortable on the phone, or you only want to do chat and

You measure your work in calls made rather than results

You want a narrow job description that never changes



HOW YOU WILL BE MEASURED



On one thing: vehicles that come through our bay doors because you got them there. Not calls made, not messages sent, not appointments booked. Vehicles that arrive and get worked on. We will show you the number every week, and we pay you on it.



COMPENSATION



USD $4.50 to $5.50 per hour depending on experience. Performance commissions for vehicles that arrive because of your outreach begin after a 90-day trial period. Paid twice a month in USD via Wise, PayPal, or direct deposit.



This is a long-term role, not a project. The right person grows with the shop, and we treat long-term contributors well.



TO APPLY, INCLUDE



*A 2-minute voice or video recording in English. Tell us about a customer or prospect you got to say yes after they had already said no. What did you actually do?

*A short note on your last phone-heavy role and what number you were measured on. Give us the real figure.

*A writing sample. Write the actual text message you would send to a customer whose truck was inspected six weeks ago, who was quoted $1,800 in brake and suspension work, and who never scheduled it. Keep it under 60 words.

*Written confirmation that you can work 8:00 PM to 3:00 AM Manila time, Monday to Friday, long term.

*A description of your internet setup and your backup plan for power and connection.

*The word AIRBRAKE somewhere in your application.



Applications without the voice recording and the writing sample will not be reviewed.

title: Medior Funnelbuilder for health and beauty brand
description:
Medior Funnel Builder — Vitaronne (DTC Beauty, Québec Market)



Role: Medior Funnel Builder

Brand: Vitaronne — premium beauty & skincare, direct-to-consumer (DTC)

Market: French-speaking Canada (Québec)

Engagement: Fixed-price project-based (milestone payments)

Location: Remote (OnlineJobs.ph platform)



About Vitaronne



Vitaronne is a European-operated DTC brand selling premium beauty and skincare products to the Québec market. We run a Meta ads → landing page → Shopify checkout → post-purchase flow ecosystem. All copy is in Québec French; all campaigns comply with Canadian cosmetic and consumer protection law.



The Role



You will design, build, and optimize sales funnels that convert cold traffic into customers and drive repeat revenue. Your core deliverables are:



Advertorial funnel pages (Funnelish): lead-capture landing pages designed around Meta ads campaigns

Post-purchase upsell flows (ReConvert): 1-click offer + downsell + thank-you page sequences

Checkout optimization: Shopify checkout pages, field streamlining, trust signals

 funnel coordination: work with Klaviyo flow sequences to nurture post-purchase customers

Testing & iteration: A/B test copy, layout, CTA placement, and conversion paths; report lift via screenshots/analytics

What You'll Build

Landing pages that match advertorial formats (no dark patterns; transparent "Publireportage" disclosure per Québec law)

Post-purchase checkout flows with cosmetic-only claims (no efficacy statements)

Multi-step funnels that guide cold prospects → product buyer → repeat customer

Conversion-optimized pages using copywriting, layout design, form psychology, and social proof

Success Metrics

Page load speed < 3s

Clear CTA hierarchy and visual flow

Compliance with Québec consumer law (LPC, Bill 96, CASL)

Post-launch A/B testing recommendations with 50%+ sample size per variant

Who You Are

3–5 years building sales funnels (landing pages, checkout flows, post-purchase upsells)

Experience with Shopify, Funnelish (or similar landing-page builders), and ReConvert (or 
)

Comfortable with Meta ads ecosystem: understand pixel events, retargeting, funnel attribution

Strong copywriting or copywriting collaboration: can write or brief compelling funnel copy

A/B testing mindset: comfortable testing, measuring, and iterating on conversion metrics

Attention to compliance: can follow checklists (e.g., no false scarcity, no pre-ticked upsells, explicit copy guardrails)

Proactive communicator: deliver work with progress screenshots, status updates, and rationale behind choices

Nice to Have

Experience with Klaviyo
 flows or post-purchase automation

DTC / e-commerce background (beauty, skincare, supplements, health)

Familiarity with ROAS tracking and basic conversion analytics

French-Canadian language skills (helpful for understanding audience nuance, not required)

We Don't Need

Designers (we handle brand visuals)

Copy specialists (you work within approved copy or we provide translated drafts)

Growth strategists (your job is execution, not strategy)

How We Work

Milestone-gated payments: each deliverable is approved and paid upon completion and review

First deliverable = proof of concept: initial project is scoped small to validate quality before scaling

Fixed-price contracts: price per funnel, per month, or per milestone (we discuss scope first)

Direct feedback: you'll receive specific, actionable notes; we communicate in English

Tool stack: Shopify, Funnelish, ReConvert, Klaviyo, Meta Ads Manager, ClickUp (project tracking)

What We're Looking For Right Now



We need a reliable funnel builder who can:



Build an advertorial landing page in Funnelish that converts cold Meta traffic (beauty/skincare vertical)

Design a post-purchase upsell flow in ReConvert with 1-click offer + downsell + thank-you page

Coordinate with Klaviyo flows to hand off
 sequences post-checkout

Follow compliance checklists (French-Canadian copy, no false claims, Publireportage disclosure, CASL footer)

Report results: share conversion data, A/B test recommendations, and next-step priorities

Application & Test Task



If your background matches, we'll send a small test project (single landing page or post-purchase flow, fixed price). This is your opportunity to show quality and communication style. Successful test tasks often lead to ongoing retainer work.



Key Details

Scope: start with 1–2 funnel builds, then scale to ongoing optimization and testing

Timeline: expect 2–3 week turnaround per funnel from briefing to live

Communication: async via
, ClickUp comments, and occasional Zoom calls

Payment: fixed price per milestone, paid upon approval (PayPal or Wise)

How to Apply



Reply with:



Your 3 best funnel examples (links to live funnels or case study screenshots)

Tools you've used: list Funnelish, ReConvert, Shopify, Klaviyo experience (or similar)

DTC/e-commerce background: how many years and which verticals

One sentence on why you're interested in Vitaronne

Filter word: The word that best describes successful funnel optimization (look for it in the job post)



We'll review carefully and reach out to strong candidates within 48–72 hours.



Why Vitaronne

Real DTC traction: we're not testing; we're scaling a brand with real customer acquisition and retention

Compliance-first mindset: you'll learn to build funnels within legal guardrails, a skill valuable across markets

Long-term partnership: strong test-task performers often become ongoing retainer team members

Clear success metrics: you'll see ROAS, conversion rate, and customer feedback — no vanity metrics



Let's build something.

title: Ad Video Editor
description:
Hi!



I run an e-commerce business from Sweden. Right now I mainly sell exfoliating shower towels, but I'll probably be launching more products going forward, and some of them will be under completely different brands. So over time you'll be editing ads for different products and brands, not just one. I'm looking for a video editor to help me make these ad videos for
 and Instagram.



How it works:

I'll send you a voice over together with the script. The voice overs will be in Swedish, Norwegian or Danish, so I'll also send an English version of the script so you know exactly what's being said. You don't need to speak any of these languages.



Your job is to turn the voice over into a finished ad by matching clips to what's being said, so the visuals follow the voice over closely. Then you add on-screen text (copied from the script, in the same language as the voice over) and make the whole thing smooth and easy to watch. You'll get access to our product footage and UGC clips, and you can use stock footage when needed.



These are ads, not brand films. The goal is sales, so what matters most is:

- A strong first 3 seconds that makes people stop scrolling

- Clips that actually show what the voice over is talking about

- Good pacing with no dead moments

- Clear, readable text that works with the sound off

- Vertical format (9:16)



What I'm looking for:

- Experience editing short-form ads, ideally for e-commerce brands

- You understand what makes an ad sell, not just look nice

- You're reliable, take feedback well and can turn around revisions quickly

- Good communication. If something is unclear, just ask me

- Good English



Nice to have:

- Experience with UGC-style ads

- You'
 edited
/Instagram ads before and have a feel for what performs



This is ongoing work if we're a good fit. I'd much rather work long term with one great editor than keep switching.

* Categorize income, expenses, and bank transactions

* Prepare and send invoices and monitor outstanding balances

title: Creative Marketing & Virtual Assistant Contractor
description:
# Creative Marketing & Virtual Assistant Contractor



**Part-Time Contract | Remote | Opportunity to Grow**



Hi! I’m Carly, founder of **HIDARI Group**, a growing Canadian business optimization and implementation company.



HIDARI works with service-based business owners who need help improving their operations, systems, marketing, digital presence and growth. Our approach goes beyond giving clients a strategy — we help turn that strategy into something that actually works in their business.



As we grow, I’m looking for a few talented **part-time contractors to join our Creative Marketing & Virtual Assistant team.**



## The Kind of Person I’m Looking For



This role is for someone who likes to create, think, organize and solve problems.



I’m **not** looking for someone who simply waits for instructions and checks tasks off a list.



I’m looking for someone who sees an opportunity and says:



*"I have an idea. What if we tried this?"*



You should enjoy taking an initial idea or vision and helping turn it into great content, stronger marketing and better systems. Ultimately, the work we create should help generate **real clients and real revenue**.



There is also room for the right person to take on more responsibility as HIDARI and our client base continue to grow.



## What You Could Be Working On



Your exact responsibilities will depend on your strengths, but you may help me and the team with:



* Instagram and LinkedIn content

* Engaging captions written in excellent English

* Canva graphics and carousels

* Short-form video and Reel editing

* Social media scheduling and management

* Monthly content calendars

* Lead magnets, guides and downloadable resources

* Website updates to keep sites modern, current and user-friendly

* Mini-courses and digital products

* Mailchimp
 campaigns

* Eventbrite and event promotion

* Competitor, industry and marketing research

* New ideas for generating leads and growing our clients' businesses

* Marketing project and workflow organization

* Improvements to our internal systems and processes



You absolutely do not need to be an expert in every area above. I’m much more interested in finding people who have **strong skills, initiative and a willingness to learn.**



## You’ll Probably Fit In Well If You Are:



* Fluent in written English

* Creative and comfortable sharing ideas

* Organized and dependable

* Detail-oriented

* Proactive and capable of working independently

* Confident with Canva

* Familiar with Instagram and LinkedIn

* Comfortable using ChatGPT and other AI tools to improve your work

* Open to feedback and revisions

* Willing to research and figure things out when you don’t know the answer

* Interested in continually learning and improving



## Bonus Skills



Experience in any of these areas would be an asset:



* Mailchimp

* Eventbrite

* CapCut

* Meta Business Suite

* LinkedIn marketing

* WordPress

* Basic funnel building

*
 marketing

* Digital product creation

* Website design or maintenance

* Marketing automation



## What I’d Like Us to Accomplish



During your first few months, I’d love for us to:



* Establish a strong and consistent social media presence

* Produce content people genuinely want to engage with

* Build lead magnets that bring in potential clients

* Launch strategic
 marketing campaigns

* Create mini-courses and digital products

* Develop marketing systems that generate leads consistently

* Improve our internal processes as the company grows

* Continue building HIDARI into a recognizable and trusted brand



More than anything, I want you to become familiar enough with what we’re building that you can **bring ideas to the table instead of always waiting for the next assignment.**



## How to Apply



Please send me:



* A brief introduction about yourself

* Your resume

* Your portfolio or examples of your work

* Links to social media accounts you’ve helped manage

* Your hourly rate

* Your weekly availability



To make sure you’ve read the entire posting, please begin your application with the words **"Blue Jay."**



Applications that don't include this will not be considered.



## Creative Exercise



I’m much more interested in seeing how you think than receiving something perfectly polished.



Please review **HIDARI Group** and send me the following:



**1. Instagram Carousel Idea**

Share one carousel concept. A simple written outline is completely fine.



**2. Instagram Reel Idea**

Give me the concept, opening hook and proposed caption.



**3. Lead Magnet Idea**

Suggest one free guide, checklist, quiz or downloadable resource that you think could attract potential HIDARI clients.



**4. Growth Idea**

Give me one marketing idea you think HIDARI should try and briefly explain why you think it would work.



Please don't spend hours on this. I’m looking for **creativity, initiative and how you approach marketing problems.**



## What It’s Like Working With Me



I move quickly, I have a lot of ideas, and I enjoy working with people who are comfortable contributing their own.



You’ll have room to be creative.



See something we could improve? Tell me.



Have an idea? Pitch it.



Something isn’t working? Help me understand why and figure out a better approach.



I want to build a team of talented people who enjoy producing great work together. As HIDARI grows, I want the people who helped build it to have opportunities to grow with it.



If that sounds like an environment you’d enjoy, I’d love to hear from you.



**Start your application with "Blue Jay" and tell me what you can bring to HIDARI.**

title: Full-Time WordPress Developer & SEO Website Manager
description:
FULL-TIME WORDPRESS DEVELOPER & SEO WEBSITE MANAGER

Remote (Philippines-based) | Full-time | $500 USD/month



IMPORTANT: Start your application with the word SAGE so we know you read the full post. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We're a multi-region women's health and fitness franchise (AU/NZ, Canada, US) looking for a full-time developer to own our WordPress website end-to-end — technical build work, security, SEO execution, and getting our blog/email content out the door. You'll work directly with, and be led by, our project lead in Sydney, who will give you clear written briefs, direction, and regular check-ins along the way. You won't be left to figure everything out on your own — this is a genuinely managed role with hands-on leadership.



What we're hoping for is someone who takes real ownership of the work they're given: delivers what was asked, tests it before calling it done, and flags problems early rather than going quiet — and who grows into more independence over time as they learn our systems. We don't expect you to arrive already running the whole website unsupervised.



This is a hands-on technical role, not a support/ticket role. You'll be trusted with real production systems from week one, with clear guidance every step of the way.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



WordPress Development & Site Management

- Customize and extend the site's theme (Sage/Blade framework) and flexible content fields (ACF Flexible Content / Gutenberg blocks) to build new page layouts and modules

- Maintain four regional site variants (AU, NZ, CA, US) via WPML

- Perform monthly core/theme/plugin maintenance with zero downtime

- Work in our GitHub repo — proper branches, pull requests, clear commit messages, staging deploys

- Manage WP Engine hosting (staging, deploys, backups)

- Handle API integrations — booking/scheduling platforms and GoHighLevel (GHL) automations



SEO & AI Search Visibility

- Execute on-page SEO: meta tags, header structure, image alt-text, schema/structured data (Yoast or RankMath)

- Apply AIO/AEO best practices — structuring content (FAQ/HowTo schema, answer-first formatting) so it gets picked up by Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and similar AI search tools

- Evaluate and use SEO/keyword monitoring tools (e.g. SEMrush)



Content & Campaign Distribution

- Publish weekly blog posts provided by the content team — formatting, imagery, links, SEO/AIO structure (you won't be writing the copy)

- Build, test, and deploy Mailchimp
 campaigns tied to blog content to drive traffic; manage segmentation and automated workflows



Security & Technical Health

- Manage Wordfence security, credential rotation, and secrets storage

- Run plugin audits and manage license decisions

- Proactively catch bugs, broken functionality, and site speed issues



Working with AI Tools

- Use AI coding assistants (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to speed up development — while still reviewing, understanding, and taking ownership of everything shipped

- Be ready to explain specifically how you've used AI tools on past projects, not just that you're aware of them



REQUIRED SKILLS



- 3+ years hands-on WordPress development (PHP, ACF — including Flexible Content field layouts — Gutenberg, a modern theme framework like Sage/Blade, Timber, or Roots)

- Solid Git/GitHub workflow — branching, PRs, resolving conflicts

- On-page SEO execution experience (Yoast/RankMath) and awareness of AI-search optimization trends (AIO/AEO/GEO)

- Experience with Mailchimp or a similar ESP for campaign building

- API integration experience

- Conversational English strong enough to follow Zoom calls and multi-step verbal instructions. You won't be writing marketing copy, so full fluency isn't required — but you do need to understand and be understood live. This is assessed as part of the process.

- Demonstrated experience using AI tools to speed up real development work (not just "I've heard of Copilot")

- Able to take a clear written brief and run with it, asking smart clarifying questions rather than guessing — you'll have ongoing leadership and direction, so this is about taking ownership of assigned work, not managing the whole website unsupervised



NICE-TO-HAVE



- Direct GoHighLevel experience (workflows, Communities, Courses/Memberships, Client Portal)

- Basic graphic skills in Canva or similar, for preparing blog images

- Google Analytics / Search Console experience

- Experience with Notion as a project management tool — all our documentation and project management runs through it, though this is easy to pick up if you haven't used it before



WORK STYLE WE NEED



- Full-time hours, but no fixed 9-5 required — you're welcome to structure your day however suits you, as long as your full-time hours are covered and you're available for scheduled meetings at reasonable times

- Takes a clear, written task and runs with it — you'll get direction and leadership, not silence, so this is about follow-through rather than figuring it all out alone

- Proactive communicator — flags blockers, asks sharp questions, reports back clearly rather than going quiet

- Willing to learn, adapt, and take on new challenges you're unfamiliar with — you won't know everything on day one, and that's expected



COMPENSATION & LOGISTICS



- $500 USD/month, full-time contractor role

- Fully remote

- Reports to: Project Lead (Sydney, Australia)



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with a message that starts with the word SAGE and includes LINKS to the following (Google Drive, Loom, or similar — make sure sharing is set to "anyone with the link"):



1. Your CV/resume

2. Portfolio or live site examples

3. Your GitHub profile

4. A short video (max 7 minutes) answering these prompts out loud:

   - Introduce yourself and your development background.

   - Walk us through a project you're proud of — what was your specific role?

   - Tell us about a time you got stuck on a technical problem. What did you do?

title: Compliance Manager
description:
GCC Solutions is a corporate services provider based in Dubai, UAE, working

across company formation, visa processing, accounting and corporate services,

with an operation in Saudi Arabia. This role is fully remote and based in the

Philippines.



ABOUT THE ROLE



We are hiring a Compliance Manager to own our day-to-day compliance function:

the client risk framework, screening and due diligence standards, policies and

procedures, training, and the preparation and escalation of suspicious activity.

It is a senior, hands-on role reporting directly to the Managing Director.



We are looking for someone who has run compliance in a regulated environment

rather than administered it - someone comfortable making a call on a difficult

client file and explaining the reasoning to the business.



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



- Own and maintain AML, counter-terrorist-financing and counter-proliferation-

  financing policies, procedures and internal controls

- Maintain the enterprise-wide risk assessment, including proliferation-financing risk

- Run the client due diligence and enhanced due diligence framework: beneficial

  ownership verification, PEP identification, sanctions screening and ongoing monitoring

- Assess high-risk client relationships and recommend approve, restrict or decline

- Review internal reports of suspicious activity, prepare the case file, and escalate

  to the appointed Compliance Officer for the reporting decision

- Maintain compliance records and registers to the standard the legislation requires

- Build, deliver and document ongoing AML training across the UAE and KSA operations

- Prepare for the independent AML audit and drive closure of its findings

- Advise on the risk implications of new clients, services and jurisdictions

- Report regularly to the Managing Director on compliance status and open risks



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- Seven or more years in AML or regulatory compliance, owning rather than

  administering the function

- Experience in a regulated environment - corporate services, law or accounting

  firm, bank, or other financial institution

- Practical command of sanctions screening, PEP identification, beneficial

  ownership structures and enhanced due diligence

- Familiarity with UAE or wider GCC AML requirements is a strong advantage;

  goAML exposure particularly so

- CAMS, CKYCA, ICA or equivalent certification preferred

- University degree

- The judgement and independence to hold a position under pressure, and to say

  no to revenue when the risk requires it

- Clear written and spoken English, and the ability to explain a risk decision

  to people who are not compliance specialists

- Based in the Philippines and legally authorised to work there



WHAT WE OFFER



- Full ownership of the compliance function, reporting to the Managing Director

- Exposure to UAE and Saudi regulatory frameworks

- Fully remote working

- Competitive compensation, commensurate with experience



HOW TO APPLY



Send your CV to 
 with "Compliance Manager" in the subject

line, together with a short note on one compliance decision you made that the

business did not want to hear.

title: Generative AI Specialist (Video & Image Creative) eComm
description:

You will own the end-to-end production of AI-generated video ads, UGC-style videos, and Amazon A+-inspired Product Landing Page (PLP) visual assets.



Why This Role Matters

Visual assets drive our conversion rates and customer acquisition cost (CAC). Instead of standard media production, we leverage AI workflows to test, iterate, and scale top-performing creative assets. Your output will directly impact click-through rates (CTR) and conversion rates (CVR) across our Shopify store and paid ad channels.



Core Responsibilities

1. GenAI Video Production & Editing

- Script-to-Screen Workflow: Develop storyboards, character reference sheets, location reference sheets, and product reference sheets to maintain 100% visual consistency.

- Asset Consistency: Guarantee character, product, voice, and location consistency across all video sequences while strictly adhering to brand guidelines.

- Ad Creative Execution: Produce high-converting e-commerce ad concepts and UGC-style videos optimized for paid social channels (Meta, TikTok, YouTube Short-form).

- Audio & Post-Production: Combine AI prompt engineering, precise video editing, and compelling voiceover integration to create polished final edits.



2. GenAI Image Assets & Product Landing Pages (PLP)

- Amazon A+ Strategy on Shopify: Adapt proven Amazon A+ design frameworks to elevate our Shopify product landing pages for trust building and conversion.

- Primary Images: Design high-CTR main images engineered to win the click in search and feed contexts.

- Secondary Images: Build lifestyle and educational secondary image stacks highlighting key product features and benefits.

- Below-the-Fold (BTF) Assets: Create conversion-focused content, including competitor comparison charts, benefit infographics, customer review layouts, and feature callouts.

- Angle Emulation: Analyze competitor image archives to identify missing product angles, using AI tools to render identical angles and fill visual gaps.



3. Research & Competitor Intelligence

- Mine competitor creative strategies and adjacent niches using provided e-commerce intelligence tools.

- Translate data-backed competitor insights into optimized video scripts, image concepts, and visual hooks.



Tool Stack Mastery

Candidates must demonstrate hands-on experience with the following tools:

- Video Generation & Editing: Higgsfield, Google VEO 3, SeeDance, CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro

- Voice & Synthetic Media: HeyGen, ElevenLabs

Qualifications

- Proven E-Commerce Portfolio: Mandatory portfolio showcasing previous work in AI video generation, image creation, and high-converting e-commerce ad creative.

- Competitor Intelligence Skills: Ability to extract actionable visual patterns from top-selling competitor products and apply them to new creative concepts.

- Prompt Engineering Mastery: Mastery of parameters, reference inputs, and image-to-video / text-to-video workflows across current GenAI models.



Preferred Qualifications

- Active, paid subscriptions to the required AI software tools.

- Direct experience running visual assets for high-volume Shopify storefronts.



How to Apply

- Submit your resume alongside a link to your portfolio. Ensure your portfolio clearly showcases:

- Examples of AI-generated video creative with visual consistency.

- E-commerce image designs (infographics, comparison charts, PLP stacks).

title: Travel Agent Relations Coordinator (Part Time, 20 hrs/week)
description:
ABOUT US



We are a UK-based adventure travel company operating three brands - Encounters Travel, Oasis Overland and Egypt Uncovered - running small-group tours across Africa, the Middle East, Asia and Latin America. We sell through our own websites and through a network of travel agents and travel trade partners.



We are hiring one person, part time, to look after that agent network: being the contact our agents know and trust, making sure their questions and issues get resolved, and documenting how it all works as you go. This is a focused role with a clearly defined scope and real ownership of the agent relationship.



WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING



1. Agent relationships

- Act as the named contact for our travel agents and build genuine working relationships with them

- Onboard new agents: contracts, system setup, sending documentation, and getting them set up to sell

- Stay in regular contact: checking in, sharing new tours and offers, understanding agent needs, and re-engaging agents we have not heard from in a while

- Track agent engagement so we have a clear picture of who is active and where the opportunities are



2. Escalation and problem resolution

- Act as the single point of contact for agent issues: booking queries, listing errors, commission questions and partner feedback

- Take ownership of each issue, coordinate the right people internally, and close the loop with the agent

- Keep agents updated throughout while an issue is open



3. Process and documentation

- Build out clear, reusable SOPs and checklists for agent onboarding, communication and issue handling, so the process is well documented and easy to share

- Identify ways to make the recurring parts of the role faster through templates and checklists, freeing up more time for the agent relationships themselves



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



Required:

- Excellent written English. Most of your agent contact will be by

- Confident spoken English for video calls with agents and with our UK team

- Genuinely good with people. Warm, responsive, and able to build trust with agents over time

- Able to prioritise well and balance incoming agent queries alongside your planned work

- Strong attention to detail, particularly with contracts, account setup and follow-up

- Comfortable with spreadsheets for tracking agent activity: filtering, sorting and basic formulas

- Quick to learn new systems and follow multi-step processes independently

- Reliable internet and a proper setup for video calls



Nice to have:

- Any experience in travel, tourism or hospitality

- Experience in a customer support, account management or client-facing coordinator role



You do not need to know our destinations or the travel trade already. We will teach you.



WHAT WE OFFER



- Part-time contract role with a small, friendly team

- A full structured handover, plus proper training on our industry, our products and our systems

- Clear priorities agreed up front, so you know exactly where to focus

- Autonomy to act. You will have a defined set of decisions you can make on your own from day one

- Personalised incentives for signing on significant agent partners

- Inclusion in the company's quarterly profit share

- Real ownership of the agent relationship, with direct contact with our partners



HOURS



20 hours per week with a flexible schedule. There are no fixed daily hours - you manage your own time, as long as the weekly total is met and you are available for agent and team meetings when they need to be scheduled. Those meetings will usually fall in UK working hours.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send:



1. A short note about a time you looked after a client, customer or partner over a period of time. How did you build the relationship, and how did you handle it when they needed something sorted out?



2. A one to two minute video of yourself introducing what you do. We are not looking for polish, we just want to hear you speak - you will be on calls with our partners in this role.



3. Your answer to this: an agent
s asking for an update on a client's booking. You do not have the answer yourself, and it sits with another team. What do you do in the first hour?



4. Start your application with the word "COMPASS" so we know you read the full post.



Applications without the word COMPASS and without the video will not be reviewed.

- Compensation



This is a 40+ hour/week, long-term position, but you are paid based on output rather than hourly.



$20 per approved finished minute.



3-minute video = $60

10 finished minutes = $200

50 finished minutes = $1,000

100 finished minutes = $2,000



Our current editors are typically earning around $3,000–$4,000/month, and we're continuing to grow our creative output. There is plenty of room to earn more as volume increases.



The faster you can produce great work without sacrificing quality, the more you can earn.



- Don't Apply If



* You don't have D2C/e-commerce experience

* You've barely used AI video tools

* You need to be taught these tools from scratch

* You can't consistently commit 40+ hours/week

* You need constant supervision

* You prioritize speed over quality



We want someone fast, resourceful, creative, and obsessed with AI who is constantly testing new tools and workflows.



- How to Apply



Start your application with HIGGS as Subject so we know you read the entire post.



Then answer:



1. Send 3 of the best D2C ads you've personally edited.



2. Which AI tools do you currently use regularly?



3. Walk us through your workflow for creating a 3-minute D2C ad when given a script and brand assets.



4. How many finished minutes of high-quality video can you realistically produce per week?



5. Are you available 40+ hours/week and comfortable with $20 per approved finished minute?



6. Send your best example of something you've created using AI.



- Trial Task



Final candidates will be required to complete one trial editing task based on a brief we provide.



For the trial, we will NOT provide logins to our AI tools or accounts. You will need to use your own accounts/tools to complete the trial. We cannot provide company account access to every applicant completing a trial.



Once hired, all necessary AI tools and software will be paid for/provided by us. You will not be expected to personally pay for the tools required to do your job.



Please only apply if you're comfortable with this process.



We're looking for someone who wants to become a core, long-term member of our creative team. Generic applications will be ignored.
